question: 统计各公司驾驶员中女性驾驶员的比例
query: SELECT c.company_name, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.gender='女' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(*),2) AS female_pct FROM transportation.vehicle_company c JOIN transportation.driver d ON c.company_id = d.company_id GROUP BY c.company_id;

question: 统计每个公司驾驶员中驾照状态为正常的比例
query: SELECT c.company_name, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.status='正常' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(*),2) AS valid_pct FROM transportation.vehicle_company c JOIN transportation.driver d ON c.company_id = d.company_id GROUP BY c.company_id;

question: 统计每种车型的车辆数量
query: SELECT t.type_name AS vehicle_type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code GROUP BY v.vehicle_type_code;

question: 按年份统计各车型注册数量
query: SELECT YEAR(v.register_date) AS year, t.type_name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code GROUP BY YEAR(v.register_date), t.type_name ORDER BY year, t.type_name;

question: 按车型统计车辆平均载重

question: 统计每个公司旗下各车型的车辆数量及占比百分比
query: SELECT c.company_name, t.type_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.company_id), 2) AS pct FROM transportation.vehicle_company c JOIN transportation.vehicle v ON c.company_id = v.company_id JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code GROUP BY c.company_id, t.type_name;

question: 查询武汉市的所有客车

question: 统计驾驶员的驾照领证年限分布
query: SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, issue_date, CURDATE()) > 10 THEN '10年以上' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, issue_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 5 AND 10 THEN '5-10年' ELSE '5年以下' END AS experience, COUNT(*) FROM transportation.driver GROUP BY experience;

question: 统计各公司车辆的平均载重，并筛选平均载重大于10吨的公司
query: SELECT c.company_name, AVG(v.load_capacity) AS avg_load FROM transportation.vehicle_company c JOIN transportation.vehicle v ON c.company_id = v.company_id GROUP BY c.company_id HAVING AVG(v.load_capacity) > 10;

question: 统计各公司危化品运输车的数量，只显示数量大于0的公司

question: 统计华南地区车辆数超过2辆的省份

question: 统计各公司的车辆数和驾驶员数
query: SELECT c.company_name, COUNT(DISTINCT v.vehicle_id) AS vehicle_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.driver_id) AS driver_count FROM transportation.vehicle_company c LEFT JOIN transportation.vehicle v ON c.company_id = v.company_id LEFT JOIN transportation.driver d ON c.company_id = d.company_id GROUP BY c.company_id;

question: 统计每个公司各车型的车辆数量

question: 统计每个公司拥有的危化品车辆数

question: 统计各公司拥有座位数大于30的客车数量

question: 统计每个船舶公司中船长、大副、轮机长的数量
query: SELECT sc.company_name, SUM(CASE WHEN et.type_name = '船长' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS captain_count, SUM(CASE WHEN et.type_name = '大副' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_officer_count, SUM(CASE WHEN et.type_name = '轮机长' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chief_engineer_count FROM transportation.shipping_company sc LEFT JOIN transportation.employee e ON sc.company_id = e.company_id LEFT JOIN common.employee_type_dict et ON e.employee_type_code = et.type_code GROUP BY sc.company_id;

question: 统计各车型的轻型、中型、重型车辆数量
query: SELECT t.type_name, COUNT(CASE WHEN v.load_capacity <= 5 THEN 1 END) AS light, COUNT(CASE WHEN v.load_capacity > 5 AND v.load_capacity <= 15 THEN 1 END) AS medium, COUNT(CASE WHEN v.load_capacity > 15 THEN 1 END) AS heavy FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code GROUP BY t.type_name;

question: 统计每个公司轻型货车的比例
query: SELECT c.company_name, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN v.load_capacity <=5 AND t.type_name='货车' THEN 1 END)*100.0/COUNT(*),2) AS light_truck_pct FROM transportation.vehicle_company c JOIN transportation.vehicle v ON c.company_id = v.company_id JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code GROUP BY c.company_id;

question: 统计轻型、中型、重型车辆的数量

question: 统计载重超过15吨的重型车辆占比

query: SELECT company_name FROM finance_tax.companies WHERE is_private = FALSE AND is_key_high_tech = TRUE;

question: 查询所有小型企业的名称
query: SELECT company_name FROM finance_tax.companies WHERE size_category_code = 'S';

question: 查询所有普通股票的名称和代码
query: SELECT stock_name, stock_code FROM finance_tax.stocks WHERE share_right_type = 'COMMON';

question: 列出所有股票市场分类代码及含义
query: SELECT DISTINCT s.market_class, t.type_name FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN common.dict_stock_type t ON t.type_category = 'MARKET_CLASS' AND t.type_code = s.market_class;

question: 查询所有面额股票的股票名称
query: SELECT stock_name FROM finance_tax.stocks WHERE par_value_type = 'PAR';

question: 查询所有B股股票的上市日期
query: SELECT stock_name, listing_date FROM finance_tax.stocks WHERE market_class = 'B';

question: 查询无面额股的数量
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finance_tax.stocks WHERE par_value_type = 'NO_PAR';

question: 查询所有无记名股票的股票名称
query: SELECT stock_name FROM finance_tax.stocks WHERE register_type = 'BEARER';

question: 查询A股和B股股票，并按市场分类排序
query: SELECT stock_name FROM finance_tax.stocks WHERE market_class IN ('A','B') ORDER BY market_class;

question: 统计各类股东权利类型的股票数量
query: SELECT share_right_type, COUNT(*) FROM finance_tax.stocks GROUP BY share_right_type;

question: 统计民营企业与非民营企业的平均资产总额有多少万元
query: SELECT CASE WHEN c.is_private = TRUE THEN '民营企业' ELSE '非民营企业' END AS type, AVG(r.total_assets) AS avg_total_assets FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 GROUP BY c.is_private;

question: 查询2025年度有亏损弥补的企业名称和弥补金额
query: SELECT c.company_name, r.prior_year_losses FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND r.prior_year_losses > 0;

question: 查询每个行业的公司数量
query: SELECT i.industry_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code GROUP BY i.industry_name ORDER BY cnt DESC;

question: 查询既是高新技术企业又是民营企业的公司名称
query: SELECT company_name FROM finance_tax.companies WHERE is_key_high_tech = TRUE AND is_private = TRUE;

question: 查询每只股票的历史最高收盘价及对应日期
query: SELECT s.stock_name, t.trade_date, t.close_price FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE t.close_price = (SELECT MAX(close_price) FROM finance_tax.stock_daily_trades WHERE stock_id = s.stock_id);

question: 查询2025年每个季度的最后一天各股票收盘价
query: SELECT s.stock_name, t.trade_date, t.close_price FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE t.trade_date IN ('2025-03-31','2025-06-30','2025-09-30','2025-12-31');

question: 查询每个行业平均注册资本
query: SELECT i.industry_name, AVG(c.registered_capital) FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code GROUP BY i.industry_name;

question: 查询每个规模类型的公司数量
query: SELECT s.size_name, COUNT(*) FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_size_category s ON c.size_category_code = s.size_code GROUP BY s.size_name;

question: 查询2025年度存在以前年度亏损的企业名称及亏损金额
query: SELECT c.company_name, r.prior_year_losses FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND r.prior_year_losses > 0;

question: 查询总股本大于10亿股的股票名称和股本量
query: SELECT stock_name, total_shares FROM finance_tax.stocks WHERE total_shares > 1000000000;

question: 查询各股票自上市以来的交易日数量
query: SELECT s.stock_name, COUNT(t.trade_id) FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id GROUP BY s.stock_name;

question: 查询同时满足高新技术和民营的企业数量
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finance_tax.companies WHERE is_key_high_tech = TRUE AND is_private = TRUE;

question: 查询属于“商务服务业”且为小型的企业的名称及规模
query: SELECT c.company_name, s.size_name FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code JOIN common.dict_size_category s ON c.size_category_code = s.size_code WHERE i.industry_name = '商务服务业' AND s.size_name = '小型';

question: 统计2025年现金分红总额超过1亿元的企业数量
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finance_tax.company_financials WHERE report_date = '2025-12-31' AND dividend_cash > 10000;

question: 查询各企业最新季度的总资产和总负债
query: SELECT c.company_name, f.total_assets, f.total_liabilities FROM finance_tax.company_financials f JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON f.company_id = c.company_id WHERE f.report_date = (SELECT MAX(report_date) FROM finance_tax.company_financials);

question: 查询每只股票最近一个交易日的开盘价、最高价、最低价、收盘价
query: SELECT s.stock_name, t.open_price, t.high_price, t.low_price, t.close_price FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE t.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM finance_tax.stock_daily_trades);

question: 查询每个企业最早的申报年份
query: SELECT c.company_name, MIN(r.tax_year) FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id GROUP BY c.company_name;

question: 查询属于中型规模的高新技术企业名称
query: SELECT c.company_name FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_size_category s ON c.size_category_code = s.size_code WHERE s.size_name = '中型' AND c.is_key_high_tech = TRUE;

question: 计算每只股票2025年的日均成交量
query: SELECT s.stock_name, AVG(t.volume) FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE t.trade_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY s.stock_name;

question: 查询非民营且非高新技术企业的平均员工人数
query: SELECT AVG(r.employee_count) FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND c.is_private = FALSE AND c.is_key_high_tech = FALSE;

question: 查询2025年度每月的总成交量（按月汇总）
query: SELECT MONTH(trade_date) AS month, SUM(volume) FROM finance_tax.stock_daily_trades WHERE trade_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY MONTH(trade_date);

question: 查询合伙企业的平均注册资本
query: SELECT AVG(c.registered_capital) FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_registration_type rt ON c.registration_type_code = rt.type_code WHERE rt.type_name = '合伙企业';

question: 查询非民营且为大型企业的公司名称和注册资金
query: SELECT c.company_name, c.registered_capital FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_size_category s ON c.size_category_code = s.size_code WHERE s.size_name = '大型' AND c.is_private = FALSE;

question: 查询上市公司中，规模为大型或中型的公司数量
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_size_category s ON c.size_category_code = s.size_code WHERE s.size_name IN ('大型','中型');

question: 查询每个股票自上市以来最高价出现的日期
query: SELECT s.stock_name, t2.trade_date, t2.high_price FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t2 ON s.stock_id = t2.stock_id WHERE t2.high_price = (SELECT MAX(high_price) FROM finance_tax.stock_daily_trades WHERE stock_id = s.stock_id);

question: 查询2025年第三季度末各公司的总资产和总负债
query: SELECT c.company_name, f.total_assets, f.total_liabilities FROM finance_tax.company_financials f JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON f.company_id = c.company_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-09-30';

question: 查询所有民营企业的注册类型名称
query: SELECT c.company_name, rt.type_name FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_registration_type rt ON c.registration_type_code = rt.type_code WHERE c.is_private = TRUE;

question: 查询计算机通信电子设备制造业中的高新技术企业
query: SELECT c.company_name FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE i.industry_name = '计算机、通信和其他电子设备制造业' AND c.is_key_high_tech = TRUE;

question: 查询每只股票成交量最大的一天及成交量
query: SELECT s.stock_name, t.trade_date, t.volume FROM finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON t.stock_id = s.stock_id WHERE t.volume = (SELECT MAX(volume) FROM finance_tax.stock_daily_trades WHERE stock_id = s.stock_id);

question: 查询每只股票每年的平均收盘价
query: SELECT s.stock_name, YEAR(t.trade_date) AS yr, AVG(t.close_price) FROM finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON t.stock_id = s.stock_id GROUP BY s.stock_name, yr;

question: 查询2025年年末的股票收盘价
query: SELECT s.stock_name, t.close_price AS price_end FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31';

question: 查询注册类型不是有限责任公司或股份有限公司的企业
query: SELECT c.company_name FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_registration_type rt ON c.registration_type_code = rt.type_code WHERE rt.type_name NOT IN ('有限责任公司','股份有限公司');

question: 统计2025年各股票有多少天收盘价高于开盘价
query: SELECT s.stock_name, COUNT(t.trade_id) FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE t.close_price > t.open_price AND t.trade_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY s.stock_name;

question: 哪个行业的小型微利企业数量最多？
query: SELECT i.industry_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE GROUP BY i.industry_name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1;

question: 查询属于“大型”企业的公司名称和规模类型
query: SELECT c.company_name, s.size_name FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_size_category s ON c.size_category_code = s.size_code WHERE s.size_name = '大型';

question: 查询2025年度从业人数少于50人的小型企业
query: SELECT c.company_name, r.employee_count FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND r.employee_count < 50 AND c.size_category_code = 'S';

question: 查询所有微型企业的公司名称和规模
query: SELECT c.company_name, s.size_name FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_size_category s ON c.size_category_code = s.size_code WHERE s.size_code = 'XS';

question: 统计各注册类型企业2025年平均扣除金额
query: SELECT rt.type_name, AVG(r.deductions) FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_registration_type rt ON c.registration_type_code = rt.type_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 GROUP BY rt.type_name;

question: 查询所有记名股票的股票名称和记名方式
query: SELECT stock_name, '记名股票' AS type FROM finance_tax.stocks WHERE register_type = 'REGISTERED';

question: 查询H股和N股股票代码及名称
query: SELECT stock_code, stock_name FROM finance_tax.stocks WHERE market_class IN ('H', 'N');

question: 查询所有无面额股且是优先股的股票
query: SELECT stock_name FROM finance_tax.stocks WHERE par_value_type = 'NO_PAR' AND share_right_type = 'PREFERRED';

question: 查询上市地点在境外（非A股）的股票数量
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finance_tax.stocks WHERE market_class != 'A';

question: 列出所有记名且为A股的股票代码
query: SELECT stock_code FROM finance_tax.stocks WHERE register_type = 'REGISTERED' AND market_class = 'A';

question: 查询所有优先股且为A股的股票
query: SELECT stock_name FROM finance_tax.stocks WHERE share_right_type = 'PREFERRED' AND market_class = 'A';

question: 查询非A股的优先股股票
query: SELECT stock_name FROM finance_tax.stocks WHERE share_right_type = 'PREFERRED' AND market_class != 'A';

question: 计算2024年12月31日所有A股上市公司的市净率，按从高到低排列
query: SELECT s.stock_name, (t.close_price / ((f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares)) AS pb FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE s.market_class = 'A' AND t.trade_date = '2024-12-31' AND f.report_date = '2024-12-31' ORDER BY pb DESC;

question: 查询2025年度股息率高于3%的股票及其股息率
query: SELECT s.stock_name, (f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s.current_price * 100 AS dy FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND (f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s.current_price * 100 > 3;

question: 计算2025年度小型微利企业数量占全部申报企业的比例
query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS small_profit_pct FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r WHERE r.tax_year = 2025;

question: 查询2025年12月31日每只股票的成交量和换手率
query: SELECT s.stock_name, t.volume, (t.volume / s.total_shares * 100) AS turnover_rate FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE t.trade_date = '2025-12-31';

question: 查询所有上市公司最近一期的资产负债率
query: SELECT c.company_name, (f.total_liabilities / f.total_assets * 100) AS debt_ratio FROM finance_tax.company_financials f JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON f.company_id = c.company_id WHERE f.report_date = (SELECT MAX(report_date) FROM finance_tax.company_financials);

question: 基于最新财报计算每只股票的每股收益
query: SELECT s.stock_name, ((f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) * 10000 / s.total_shares) AS eps FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE f.report_date = (SELECT MAX(report_date) FROM finance_tax.company_financials);

question: 计算各行业2025年平均股息率
query: SELECT i.industry_name, AVG((f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s.current_price * 100) AS avg_dy FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON s.company_id = c.company_id JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.industry_name;

question: 统计各行业高新技术企业平均市净率
query: SELECT i.industry_name, AVG(t.close_price / ((f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares)) AS avg_pb FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON s.company_id = c.company_id JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE c.is_key_high_tech = TRUE AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31' AND f.report_date = '2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.industry_name;

question: 查询2025年度各公司相对于2024年度的收入增长率，列出公司名称及增长率
query: SELECT c.company_name, (r2025.revenue - r2024.revenue) / r2024.revenue * 100 AS growth_rate FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r2025 JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r2024 ON r2025.company_id = r2024.company_id AND r2024.tax_year = 2024 JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r2025.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r2025.tax_year = 2025;

question: 计算2025年净资产收益率最高的前五只股票
query: SELECT s.stock_name, ((f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) * 10000 / s.total_shares) / ((f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares) * 100 AS roe FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' ORDER BY roe DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 计算每只股票最近交易日的涨跌幅
query: SELECT s.stock_name, ((t.close_price - t.open_price) / t.open_price * 100) AS change_pct FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE t.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM finance_tax.stock_daily_trades);

question: 计算所有A股在2025年12月31日的平均市盈率
query: SELECT AVG(t.close_price / (((f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) * 10000) / s.total_shares)) AS avg_pe FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE s.market_class = 'A' AND f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31';

question: 计算2025年度各企业的红利支付率
query: SELECT c.company_name, (f.dividend_cash / (f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) * 100) AS payout_ratio FROM finance_tax.company_financials f JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON f.company_id = c.company_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND (f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) > 0;

question: 查询市净率最低的前十只股票及其市净率
query: SELECT s.stock_name, (t.close_price / ((f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares)) AS pb FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31' ORDER BY pb LIMIT 10;

question: 查询优先股股票中，每股净资产最高的前两名
query: SELECT s.stock_name, (f.total_assets * 10000 / s.total_shares) AS bps FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE s.share_right_type = 'PREFERRED' AND f.report_date = '2025-12-31' ORDER BY bps DESC LIMIT 2;

question: 查询股息率排名前三的股票
query: SELECT s.stock_name, (f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s.current_price * 100 AS dy FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' ORDER BY dy DESC LIMIT 3;

question: 计算所有股票2025年的总成交金额（近似值）
query: SELECT SUM(t.volume * t.close_price) FROM finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t WHERE t.trade_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31';

question: 计算每只股票2025年12月31日的市盈率PE
query: SELECT s.stock_name, t.close_price / (((f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) * 10000) / s.total_shares) AS pe FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31';

question: 查询2025年每股收益高于2元的股票
query: SELECT s.stock_name, ((f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) * 10000 / s.total_shares) AS eps FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND ((f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) * 10000 / s.total_shares) > 2;

question: 计算各行业2025年平均每股净资产
query: SELECT i.industry_name, AVG((f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares) FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON s.company_id = c.company_id JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.industry_name;

question: 计算每只股票最近一期的股息率
query: SELECT s.stock_name, (f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s.current_price * 100 AS dy FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE f.report_date = (SELECT MAX(report_date) FROM finance_tax.company_financials);

question: 查询2025年每股净资产超过股价的股票（破净股）
query: SELECT s.stock_name, (f.total_assets * 10000 / s.total_shares) AS bps, s.current_price FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND (f.total_assets * 10000 / s.total_shares) > s.current_price;

question: 查询ROA最高的10家公司

question: 计算各企业2025年度的实际税负率，列出实际税负率低于15%的企业
query: SELECT c.company_name, ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END / r.revenue) * 100 AS effective_rate FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 HAVING effective_rate < 15;

query: SELECT ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.25) / 1800 AS ratio FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '顺丰控股' AND r.tax_year = 2025;

question: 计算万科A 2025年股息率与行业平均股息率的差值有多少百分点
query: SELECT (f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s.current_price * 100 - 2.3 AS diff_pct FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '万科A' AND f.report_date = '2025-12-31';

question: 计算中国平安2025年市净率与行业平均市净率的差值
query: SELECT t.close_price / ((f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares) - 1.42 AS pb_diff FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE s.stock_name = '中国平安保险' AND f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31';

question: 中国石化2025年度的应纳税所得额高于行业平均水平多少万元
query: SELECT (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) - 6200 AS exceed_amount FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '中国石化' AND r.tax_year = 2025;

question: 请计算顺丰速运2025年收入与其所在行业平均收入的差值有多少亿元
query: SELECT (r.revenue - 17500) / 10000 AS diff_yi FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '顺丰速运' AND r.tax_year = 2025;

question: 计算万科物业2025年总市值是行业平均市值的多少倍
query: SELECT (s.current_price * s.total_shares) / 123000000000 AS ratio FROM finance_tax.stocks s WHERE s.stock_name = '万科物业';

question: 请计算万科物业2025年所得税费用相对于行业平均所得税费用的比值
query: SELECT ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.25) / 1625 AS ratio FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '万科物业' AND r.tax_year = 2025;

question: 计算中国石化2025年股息率与行业平均股息率的差值有多少百分点
query: SELECT (f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s.current_price * 100 - 6.375 AS diff_pct FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '中国石化' AND f.report_date = '2025-12-31';

question: 查询同时满足高新技术和先进型服务企业的名单
query: SELECT company_name FROM finance_tax.companies WHERE is_key_high_tech = TRUE AND is_tech_advanced_service = TRUE;

question: 查询不征税收入占收入比例超过20%的企业名单
query: SELECT c.company_name, (r.non_taxable_income / r.revenue * 100) AS ratio FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND r.non_taxable_income / r.revenue > 0.2;

question: 找出同时满足高新技术和先进型服务的企业，并计算其平均资产总额
query: SELECT AVG(r.total_assets) FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND c.is_key_high_tech = TRUE AND c.is_tech_advanced_service = TRUE;

question: 查询登记注册类型为股份有限公司且为民营的企业中，高新技术企业比例
query: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS pct FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_registration_type rt ON c.registration_type_code = rt.type_code WHERE rt.type_name = '股份有限公司' AND c.is_private = TRUE;

question: 各行业的平均扣除金额占收入比例
query: SELECT i.industry_name, AVG(r.deductions / r.revenue) * 100 AS deduction_ratio FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 GROUP BY i.industry_name;

question: 各行业公司总数及高新技术企业数
query: SELECT i.industry_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.company_id) AS total_companies, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN c.company_id END) AS high_tech_companies FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code GROUP BY i.industry_name;

question: 按注册类型比较平均注册资本和平均收入
query: SELECT rt.type_name, AVG(c.registered_capital) AS avg_capital, AVG(r.revenue) AS avg_revenue FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_registration_type rt ON c.registration_type_code = rt.type_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 GROUP BY rt.type_name;

question: 查询高新技术企业2024和2025两年的收入
query: SELECT c.company_name, r.tax_year, r.revenue FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE c.is_key_high_tech = TRUE AND r.tax_year IN (2024,2025) ORDER BY c.company_name, r.tax_year;

question: 比较各行业小型微利企业与高新技术企业的所得税优惠总额
query: SELECT i.industry_name, SUM(CASE WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE AND c.is_key_high_tech = FALSE THEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.05 WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.10 ELSE 0 END) AS tax_benefit FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 GROUP BY i.industry_name;

question: 分析各行业是否都存在小型微利企业
query: SELECT i.industry_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_small FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 GROUP BY i.industry_name;

question: 查询符合小型微利条件的民营企业数量占民营企业总数的比例
query: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS ratio FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND c.is_private = TRUE;

question: 比较有限责任公司与股份有限公司小型微利企业占比
query: SELECT rt.type_name, SUM(CASE WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS pct FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_registration_type rt ON c.registration_type_code = rt.type_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND rt.type_name IN ('有限责任公司','股份有限公司') GROUP BY rt.type_name;

question: 在满足小型微利条件的企业中，同时被认定为高新技术企业的占比
query: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS pct FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE;

question: 列出不属于小型微利企业的高新技术企业名单及其应纳税所得额
query: SELECT c.company_name, (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) AS taxable_income FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND c.is_key_high_tech = TRUE AND NOT ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE);

question: 查询非民营企业中，小型微利企业所占比例
query: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS ratio FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND c.is_private = FALSE;

question: 查询民营高新技术企业中，不符合小型微利条件的企业数量
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND c.is_private = TRUE AND c.is_key_high_tech = TRUE AND NOT ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE);

question: 查询那些既不是高新技术企业也不是小型微利企业的公司2025年平均税负
query: SELECT AVG((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.25 / r.revenue) AS tax_burden FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND c.is_key_high_tech = FALSE AND NOT ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE);

question: 按注册类型统计企业总数和小型微利企业数
query: SELECT rt.type_name, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS small_count FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_registration_type rt ON c.registration_type_code = rt.type_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 GROUP BY rt.type_name;

question: 查询2025年度同时满足股息率>2%且市净率<1.5的股票
query: SELECT s.stock_name, (f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s.current_price * 100 AS dy, t.close_price / ((f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares) AS pb FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31' AND (f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s.current_price * 100 > 2 AND t.close_price / ((f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares) < 1.5;

question: 找出那些2025年收入小于扣除金额且有亏损弥补的企业
query: SELECT c.company_name, r.revenue, r.deductions, r.prior_year_losses FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND r.revenue < r.deductions AND r.prior_year_losses > 0;

question: 查询那些在2025年收入增长但所得税下降的企业，与2024比
query: SELECT c.company_name FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r2025 JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r2024 ON r2025.company_id = r2024.company_id AND r2024.tax_year = 2024 JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r2025.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r2025.tax_year = 2025 AND r2025.revenue > r2024.revenue AND (r2025.revenue - r2025.non_taxable_income - r2025.deductions - r2025.prior_year_losses) < (r2024.revenue - r2024.non_taxable_income - r2024.deductions - r2024.prior_year_losses);

question: 查询2025年度企业集中度CR1
query: SELECT i.industry_name, MAX(r.revenue) / SUM(r.revenue) * 100 AS top1_pct FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 GROUP BY i.industry_name;

question: 查询2025年各企业适用的所得税税率及应纳税所得额，按税率从低到高排列
query: SELECT c.company_name, (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) AS taxable, CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END AS rate FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 ORDER BY rate, taxable DESC;

question: 查询2025年应纳税所得额超过500万元的民营企业
query: SELECT c.company_name, (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) AS taxable FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND c.is_private = TRUE AND (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) > 500;

question: 查询非高新民营企业的2025年应纳税所得额前十名
query: SELECT c.company_name, (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) AS taxable FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND c.is_key_high_tech = FALSE AND (c.is_private = TRUE) AND (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) > 0 ORDER BY taxable DESC LIMIT 10;

question: 计算2025年市净率低于1的股票数量和平均市净率
query: SELECT COUNT(*), AVG(pb) FROM (SELECT t.close_price / ((f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares) AS pb FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31') sub WHERE pb < 1;

question: 查询股息率排名前10的股票所在行业分布
query: SELECT i.industry_name, COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.industry_code FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON s.company_id = c.company_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' ORDER BY (f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s.current_price * 100 DESC LIMIT 10) t JOIN common.dict_industry i ON t.industry_code = i.industry_code GROUP BY i.industry_name;

question: 计算各股票2024年对比2023年的每股收益增长率
query: SELECT s.stock_name, ((eps2024.eps - eps2023.eps) / eps2023.eps * 100) AS growth FROM (SELECT s.stock_id, ((f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) * 10000 / s.total_shares) AS eps FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE f.report_date = '2024-12-31') eps2024 JOIN (SELECT s.stock_id, ((f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) * 10000 / s.total_shares) AS eps FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE f.report_date = '2023-12-31') eps2023 ON eps2024.stock_id = eps2023.stock_id JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON eps2024.stock_id = s.stock_id WHERE eps2023.eps > 0;

question: 计算小型微利企业的平均资产周转率
query: SELECT AVG(r.revenue / r.total_assets) FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE;

question: 查找2025年底股息率大于2%的股票
query: SELECT s.stock_name, (f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s.current_price * 100 AS dy FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND (f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s.current_price * 100 > 2;

question: 查询2025年价格波动率最大的前五只股票
query: SELECT s.stock_name, (MAX(t.close_price) - MIN(t.close_price)) / AVG(t.close_price) AS volatility FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE t.trade_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY s.stock_name ORDER BY volatility DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 比较信息技术行业与全市场平均市净率
query: SELECT AVG(t.close_price / ((f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares)) AS market_pb, AVG(CASE WHEN c.industry_code = 'I65' THEN t.close_price / ((f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares) END) AS tech_pb FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON s.company_id = c.company_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31';

question: 比较不同企业注册类型的平均企业所得税税额
query: SELECT rt.type_name, AVG((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END) AS avg_tax FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_registration_type rt ON c.registration_type_code = rt.type_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 GROUP BY rt.type_name ORDER BY avg_tax DESC;

question: 计算各企业2025年实际税负率，找出税负率最低的前三名
query: SELECT c.company_name, ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END / NULLIF(r.revenue,0)) AS tax_burden FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 ORDER BY tax_burden LIMIT 3;

question: 计算各企业2025年度的所得税贡献率
query: SELECT c.company_name, ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END / r.total_assets) * 100 AS contribution FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 ORDER BY contribution DESC LIMIT 10;

question: 分析行业平均税负率与行业平均市净率的关系
query: SELECT i.industry_name, AVG((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END / r.revenue) AS tax_burden, AVG(t.close_price / ((f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares)) AS pb FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r ON c.company_id = r.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON c.company_id = s.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON c.company_id = f.company_id JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31' AND f.report_date = '2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.industry_name;

question: 计算2025年度各企业应纳税所得额的同比变化率
query: SELECT c.company_name, ((r2025.taxable - r2024.taxable) / r2024.taxable * 100) AS change_rate FROM (SELECT company_id, revenue - non_taxable_income - deductions - prior_year_losses AS taxable FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns WHERE tax_year = 2025) r2025 JOIN (SELECT company_id, revenue - non_taxable_income - deductions - prior_year_losses AS taxable FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns WHERE tax_year = 2024) r2024 ON r2025.company_id = r2024.company_id JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r2025.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r2024.taxable > 0;

question: 计算各企业2025年所得税费用相对于净利润的比率
query: SELECT c.company_name, ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END) / (f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) * 100 AS tax_to_profit FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON c.company_id = f.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND (f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) > 0;

question: 计算小型微利企业相对于25%税率节省的税额
query: SELECT c.company_name, ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.05) AS tax_reduction FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND c.is_key_high_tech = FALSE AND (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE;

question: 统计大型电力企业中各岗位类别员工的学历分布占比
query: SELECT ep.category, e.education, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(*)*100.0/SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY ep.category) AS pct FROM energy.employee e JOIN energy.energy_company ec ON e.company_id = ec.company_id JOIN common.energy_position_dict ep ON e.position_code = ep.position_code WHERE ec.staff_count >= 5000 GROUP BY ep.category, e.education;

question: 统计各电力企业可再生能源装机容量和员工数量的综合排名
query: SELECT ec.company_name, SUM(CASE WHEN et.is_renewable=1 THEN es.installed_capacity ELSE 0 END) AS renewable_capacity, COUNT(DISTINCT e.employee_id) AS employee_count FROM energy.energy_company ec JOIN energy.energy_station es ON ec.company_id = es.company_id JOIN common.energy_type_dict et ON es.energy_type_code = et.type_code LEFT JOIN energy.employee e ON ec.company_id = e.company_id GROUP BY ec.company_id, ec.company_name ORDER BY renewable_capacity DESC;

question: 统计各省份清洁能源装机占比
query: SELECT LEFT(es.area_id,2) AS province_code, SUM(CASE WHEN et.category='清洁能源' THEN es.installed_capacity ELSE 0 END)*100.0/SUM(es.installed_capacity) AS clean_pct FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.energy_type_dict et ON es.energy_type_code = et.type_code GROUP BY LEFT(es.area_id,2);

question: 统计三北地区各省份的风电和光伏装机容量
query: SELECT LEFT(area_id,2) AS province_code, SUM(CASE WHEN energy_type_code='WIND' THEN installed_capacity ELSE 0 END) AS wind_capacity, SUM(CASE WHEN energy_type_code='SOLAR' THEN installed_capacity ELSE 0 END) AS solar_capacity FROM energy.energy_station WHERE LEFT(area_id,2) IN ('11','12','13','14','15','21','22','23','61','62','63','64','65') GROUP BY LEFT(area_id,2);

question: 统计各省份电力企业员工中博士学历的数量和占比
query: SELECT LEFT(ec.area_id,2) AS province_code, SUM(CASE WHEN e.education='博士' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS doctor_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.education='博士' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(*) AS doctor_pct FROM energy.energy_company ec JOIN energy.employee e ON ec.company_id = e.company_id GROUP BY LEFT(ec.area_id,2);

question: 统计华东地区各省份电力企业中拥有风电场的企业占比
query: SELECT LEFT(ec.area_id,2) AS province_code, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN es.station_type_code='WP' THEN ec.company_id END) AS wind_company_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ec.company_id) AS total_company_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN es.station_type_code='WP' THEN ec.company_id END)*100.0/COUNT(DISTINCT ec.company_id) AS wind_pct FROM energy.energy_company ec LEFT JOIN energy.energy_station es ON ec.company_id = es.company_id WHERE LEFT(ec.area_id,2) IN ('31','32','33','34','35','36','37') GROUP BY LEFT(ec.area_id,2);

question: 统计西部地区各省份新能源发电场站的装机容量占比
query: SELECT LEFT(es.area_id,2) AS province_code, SUM(CASE WHEN et.is_renewable=1 THEN es.installed_capacity ELSE 0 END)*100.0/SUM(es.installed_capacity) AS renewable_pct FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.energy_type_dict et ON es.energy_type_code = et.type_code WHERE LEFT(es.area_id,2) IN ('50','51','52','53','54','61','62','63','64','65') GROUP BY LEFT(es.area_id,2);

question: 统计三北地区各省份清洁能源装机容量占总装机容量的比例
query: SELECT LEFT(es.area_id,2) AS province_code, SUM(CASE WHEN et.category='清洁能源' THEN es.installed_capacity ELSE 0 END)*100.0/SUM(es.installed_capacity) AS clean_pct FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.energy_type_dict et ON es.energy_type_code = et.type_code WHERE LEFT(es.area_id,2) IN ('11','12','13','14','15','21','22','23','61','62','63','64','65') GROUP BY LEFT(es.area_id,2);

question: 统计各省级行政区电力企业中清洁能源装机容量占比超过50%的省份
query: SELECT LEFT(es.area_id,2) AS province_code, SUM(CASE WHEN et.category='清洁能源' THEN es.installed_capacity ELSE 0 END)*100.0/SUM(es.installed_capacity) AS clean_pct FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.energy_type_dict et ON es.energy_type_code = et.type_code GROUP BY LEFT(es.area_id,2) HAVING clean_pct > 50;

question: 统计西部各省份发电场站中水电站装机容量与总装机容量的比例
query: SELECT LEFT(area_id,2) AS province_code, SUM(CASE WHEN energy_type_code='HYDRO' THEN installed_capacity ELSE 0 END)*100.0/SUM(installed_capacity) AS hydro_pct FROM energy.energy_station WHERE LEFT(area_id,2) IN ('50','51','52','53','54','61','62','63','64','65') GROUP BY LEFT(area_id,2);

question: 统计各省级行政区清洁能源发电场站的员工数量占该省电力企业总员工的比例
query: SELECT LEFT(es.area_id,2) AS province_code, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN et.category='清洁能源' THEN e.employee_id END) AS clean_employee_count, COUNT(DISTINCT e.employee_id) AS total_employee_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN et.category='清洁能源' THEN e.employee_id END)*100.0/COUNT(DISTINCT e.employee_id) AS clean_pct FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.energy_type_dict et ON es.energy_type_code = et.type_code JOIN energy.employee e ON es.station_id = e.station_id GROUP BY LEFT(es.area_id,2);

question: 统计各省份电力企业中技术岗位员工的占比
query: SELECT LEFT(ec.area_id,2) AS province_code, SUM(CASE WHEN ep.category='技术' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(*) AS tech_pct FROM energy.employee e JOIN energy.energy_company ec ON e.company_id = ec.company_id JOIN common.energy_position_dict ep ON e.position_code = ep.position_code GROUP BY LEFT(ec.area_id,2);

question: 统计珠三角各城市电力企业中拥有安全生产许可证的企业占比
query: SELECT LEFT(ec.area_id,4) AS city_code, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cc.cert_type='安全生产许可证' THEN ec.company_id END) AS safety_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ec.company_id) AS total_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cc.cert_type='安全生产许可证' THEN ec.company_id END)*100.0/COUNT(DISTINCT ec.company_id) AS safety_pct FROM energy.energy_company ec LEFT JOIN energy.company_certification cc ON ec.company_id = cc.company_id WHERE LEFT(ec.area_id,4) IN ('4401','4403','4404','4406','4413','4419','4420','4407','4412') GROUP BY LEFT(ec.area_id,4);

question: 统计各省份电力企业中30岁以下技术岗位员工的占比
query: SELECT LEFT(ec.area_id,2) AS province_code, SUM(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.birth_date, CURDATE()) < 30 AND ep.category='技术' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(*) AS young_tech_pct FROM energy.employee e JOIN energy.energy_company ec ON e.company_id = ec.company_id JOIN common.energy_position_dict ep ON e.position_code = ep.position_code GROUP BY LEFT(ec.area_id,2);

question: 统计各省份电力企业中运行岗位员工的占比
query: SELECT LEFT(ec.area_id,2) AS province_code, SUM(CASE WHEN ep.category='运行' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(*) AS operation_pct FROM energy.employee e JOIN energy.energy_company ec ON e.company_id = ec.company_id JOIN common.energy_position_dict ep ON e.position_code = ep.position_code GROUP BY LEFT(ec.area_id,2);

question: 统计东部地区各省份电力企业中装机容量大于3000MW的发电场站占比
query: SELECT LEFT(area_id,2) AS province_code, SUM(CASE WHEN installed_capacity>3000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(*) AS large_station_pct FROM energy.energy_station WHERE LEFT(area_id,2) IN ('31','32','33','34','35','36','37') GROUP BY LEFT(area_id,2);

question: 统计西部地区各省份电力企业中水电场站装机容量与总装机容量的比值
query: SELECT LEFT(area_id,2) AS province_code, SUM(CASE WHEN energy_type_code='HYDRO' THEN installed_capacity ELSE 0 END)*100.0/SUM(installed_capacity) AS hydro_pct FROM energy.energy_station WHERE LEFT(area_id,2) IN ('50','51','52','53','54','61','62','63','64','65') GROUP BY LEFT(area_id,2);

question: 统计各经营类型电力企业中年利用小时数超过4000小时的发电场站数量占比
query: SELECT ec.business_type, SUM(CASE WHEN es.annual_generation/es.installed_capacity*10000>4000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(*) AS high_eff_pct FROM energy.energy_company ec JOIN energy.energy_station es ON ec.company_id = es.company_id WHERE es.annual_generation>0 AND es.installed_capacity>0 GROUP BY ec.business_type;

question: 统计大型电力企业中拥有硕士及以上学历员工的占比
query: SELECT ec.company_name, SUM(CASE WHEN e.education IN ('硕士','博士') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(*) AS master_pct FROM energy.energy_company ec JOIN energy.employee e ON ec.company_id = e.company_id WHERE ec.staff_count >= 5000 GROUP BY ec.company_id, ec.company_name;

question: 统计三北地区十四五期间投产的风电和光伏场站总装机容量
query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN energy_type_code='WIND' THEN installed_capacity ELSE 0 END) AS wind_capacity, SUM(CASE WHEN energy_type_code='SOLAR' THEN installed_capacity ELSE 0 END) AS solar_capacity FROM energy.energy_station WHERE LEFT(area_id,2) IN ('11','12','13','14','15','21','22','23','61','62','63','64','65') AND grid_connect_date >= '2021-01-01' AND grid_connect_date <= '2025-12-31';

question: 查询三北地区的总风电装机容量和总光伏装机容量
query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN energy_type_code='WIND' THEN installed_capacity ELSE 0 END) AS wind_capacity, SUM(CASE WHEN energy_type_code='SOLAR' THEN installed_capacity ELSE 0 END) AS solar_capacity FROM energy.energy_station WHERE LEFT(area_id,2) IN ('11','12','13','14','15','21','22','23','61','62','63','64','65');

question: 统计长三角地区各城市电力企业中拥有多种能源类型场站的企业数量
query: SELECT LEFT(ec.area_id,4) AS city_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ec.company_id) AS company_count FROM energy.energy_company ec JOIN energy.energy_station es ON ec.company_id = es.company_id WHERE LEFT(ec.area_id,2) IN ('31','32','33','34') GROUP BY LEFT(ec.area_id,4) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT es.energy_type_code) > 1;

question: 统计各省份电力企业中拥有3种及以上资质类型的企业数量
query: SELECT LEFT(ec.area_id,2) AS province_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ec.company_id) AS multi_cert_count FROM energy.energy_company ec JOIN energy.company_certification cc ON ec.company_id = cc.company_id GROUP BY LEFT(ec.area_id,2), ec.company_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cc.cert_type) >= 3;

question: 统计各省份电力企业中拥有双资质的企业数量
query: SELECT LEFT(ec.area_id,2) AS province_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ec.company_id) AS double_cert_count FROM energy.energy_company ec JOIN energy.company_certification cc ON ec.company_id = cc.company_id GROUP BY LEFT(ec.area_id,2), ec.company_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cc.cert_type) >= 2;

question: 统计各省份电力企业中年发电量总和超过100000万kWh的省份
query: SELECT LEFT(area_id,2) AS province_code, SUM(annual_generation) AS total_generation FROM energy.energy_station WHERE annual_generation IS NOT NULL GROUP BY LEFT(area_id,2) HAVING SUM(annual_generation) > 100000;

question: 统计京津冀地区各类型发电场站的员工平均年龄对比
query: SELECT et.type_name, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.birth_date, CURDATE())) AS avg_age FROM energy.employee e JOIN energy.energy_station es ON e.station_id = es.station_id JOIN common.energy_type_dict et ON es.energy_type_code = et.type_code WHERE LEFT(es.area_id,2) IN ('11','12','13') GROUP BY et.type_name;

question: 统计各电力企业中总装机容量排名前5的企业及其员工数量
query: SELECT ec.company_name, SUM(es.installed_capacity) AS total_capacity, COUNT(DISTINCT e.employee_id) AS employee_count FROM energy.energy_company ec JOIN energy.energy_station es ON ec.company_id = es.company_id LEFT JOIN energy.employee e ON ec.company_id = e.company_id GROUP BY ec.company_id, ec.company_name ORDER BY total_capacity DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 统计各省份电力企业中总员工数量与总装机容量的比值排名
query: SELECT LEFT(ec.area_id,2) AS province_code, COUNT(DISTINCT e.employee_id) AS total_employee, SUM(es.installed_capacity) AS total_capacity, SUM(es.installed_capacity)/COUNT(DISTINCT e.employee_id) AS capacity_per_employee FROM energy.energy_company ec JOIN energy.energy_station es ON ec.company_id = es.company_id JOIN energy.employee e ON ec.company_id = e.company_id GROUP BY LEFT(ec.area_id,2) ORDER BY capacity_per_employee DESC;

question: 统计各省份电力企业中总装机容量与员工数量的比值
query: SELECT LEFT(ec.area_id,2) AS province_code, SUM(es.installed_capacity)/COUNT(DISTINCT e.employee_id) AS capacity_per_employee FROM energy.energy_company ec JOIN energy.energy_station es ON ec.company_id = es.company_id JOIN energy.employee e ON ec.company_id = e.company_id GROUP BY LEFT(ec.area_id,2);

question: 统计珠三角各城市电力企业中拥有资质过期的企业数量
query: SELECT LEFT(ec.area_id,4) AS city_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ec.company_id) AS expired_company_count FROM energy.energy_company ec JOIN energy.company_certification cc ON ec.company_id = cc.company_id WHERE LEFT(ec.area_id,4) IN ('4401','4403','4404','4406','4413','4419','4420','4407','4412') AND cc.expire_date < CURDATE() GROUP BY LEFT(ec.area_id,4);

question: 统计长三角地区各省份清洁能源发电场站的总装机容量
query: SELECT LEFT(es.area_id,2) AS province_code, SUM(es.installed_capacity) AS clean_capacity FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.energy_type_dict et ON es.energy_type_code = et.type_code WHERE LEFT(es.area_id,2) IN ('31','32','33','34') AND et.category = '清洁能源' GROUP BY LEFT(es.area_id,2);

question: 统计各省份电力企业中拥有供电类电力业务许可证的企业数量
query: SELECT LEFT(ec.area_id,2) AS province_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ec.company_id) AS supply_cert_count FROM energy.energy_company ec JOIN energy.company_certification cc ON ec.company_id = cc.company_id WHERE cc.cert_type = '供电类电力业务许可证' GROUP BY LEFT(ec.area_id,2);

question: 统计各省份大型火电厂的数量
query: SELECT LEFT(area_id,2) AS province_code, COUNT(*) AS large_thermal_count FROM energy.energy_station WHERE station_type_code='PP' AND energy_type_code='THERMAL' AND installed_capacity >= 3000 GROUP BY LEFT(area_id,2);

question: 统计华中地区各省份大型水电厂的数量
query: SELECT LEFT(area_id,2) AS province_code, COUNT(*) AS large_hydro_count FROM energy.energy_station WHERE LEFT(area_id,2) IN ('41','42','43') AND station_type_code = 'HP' AND installed_capacity >= 1000 GROUP BY LEFT(area_id,2);

question: 统计东部地区各省份电力企业中年发电量超过100000万kWh的场站数量
query: SELECT LEFT(area_id,2) AS province_code, COUNT(*) AS high_gen_count FROM energy.energy_station WHERE LEFT(area_id,2) IN ('31','32','33','34','35','36','37') AND annual_generation > 100000 GROUP BY LEFT(area_id,2);

question: 统计各省份电力企业的数量、总员工数和平均员工规模
query: SELECT LEFT(area_id,2) AS province_code, COUNT(*) AS company_count, SUM(staff_count) AS total_staff, SUM(staff_count)/COUNT(*) AS avg_staff FROM energy.energy_company GROUP BY LEFT(area_id,2) ORDER BY company_count DESC;

question: 统计珠三角各城市发电场站中运营超过20年的老旧场站数量
query: SELECT LEFT(area_id,4) AS city_code, COUNT(*) AS old_station_count FROM energy.energy_station WHERE LEFT(area_id,4) IN ('4401','4403','4404','4406','4413','4419','4420','4407','4412') AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, grid_connect_date, CURDATE()) > 20 GROUP BY LEFT(area_id,4);

question: 统计各省份发电场站的平均运行年限和总装机容量
query: SELECT LEFT(area_id,2) AS province_code, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, grid_connect_date, CURDATE())) AS avg_years, SUM(installed_capacity) AS total_capacity FROM energy.energy_station WHERE grid_connect_date IS NOT NULL AND status = '运行' GROUP BY LEFT(area_id,2);

question: 统计各省级行政区的发电场站总装机容量，并按总装机容量降序排列
query: SELECT LEFT(area_id,2) AS province_code, SUM(installed_capacity) AS total_capacity FROM energy.energy_station GROUP BY LEFT(area_id,2) ORDER BY total_capacity DESC;

question: 统计三北地区各省份电力企业中年发电量超过装机容量4000小时的超高效火电发电场站数量
query: SELECT LEFT(area_id,2) AS province_code, COUNT(*) AS super_thermal_count FROM energy.energy_station WHERE LEFT(area_id,2) IN ('11','12','13','14','15','21','22','23','61','62','63','64','65') AND energy_type_code='THERMAL' AND annual_generation>0 AND installed_capacity>0 AND annual_generation / installed_capacity * 10>4000 GROUP BY LEFT(area_id,2);

question: 统计三北地区大型风电场的数量和总装机容量
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS wind_count, SUM(installed_capacity) AS total_capacity FROM energy.energy_station WHERE LEFT(area_id,2) IN ('11','12','13','14','15','21','22','23','61','62','63','64','65') AND station_type_code='WP' AND installed_capacity >= 500;

question: 查询西电东送送端省份的总装机容量和总年发电量
query: SELECT SUM(installed_capacity) AS total_capacity, SUM(annual_generation) AS total_generation FROM energy.energy_station WHERE LEFT(area_id,2) IN ('50','51','52','53','54','61','62','63','64','65');

question: 在电商平台上请帮我查询状态为CANCELLED的用户ID和用户名，输出结果。
query: SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM ecommerce.customer WHERE status_code = 'CANCELLED' ORDER BY customer_id;

question: 查询销量最高的20个商品
query: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity FROM ecommerce.order_item oi JOIN ecommerce.product p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY sales_quantity DESC, p.product_id ASC LIMIT 20;

question: 帮我统计LIVE渠道的订单数量，返回查询结果。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ecommerce.orders WHERE order_channel_code = 'LIVE';

question: 统计整体退款率，输出结果。
query: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN oi.refund_amount > 0 THEN o.order_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 4) AS refund_rate FROM ecommerce.orders o LEFT JOIN ecommerce.order_item oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id;

question: 请帮我统计SELF平台的GMV，返回查询结果。
query: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM ecommerce.orders WHERE platform_code = 'SELF';

question: 统计APP渠道的订单数量，输出结果。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ecommerce.orders WHERE order_channel_code = 'APP';

question: 查询应付金额大于500的订单
query: SELECT order_id, payable_amount FROM ecommerce.orders WHERE payable_amount > 500 ORDER BY order_id;

question: 请查询库存低于50的商品库存记录，输出结果。
query: SELECT product_id, warehouse_code, stock_quantity FROM ecommerce.inventory WHERE stock_quantity < 50 ORDER BY product_id, warehouse_code;

question: 帮我统计支付状态为FAILED的支付记录数量
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM ecommerce.payment WHERE payment_status_code = 'FAILED';

question: 帮我统计每个商品的销量。
query: SELECT p.product_id, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS sales_quantity FROM ecommerce.product p LEFT JOIN ecommerce.order_item oi   ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY p.product_id;

question: 查询会员等级为SILVER的用户，输出结果。
query: SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM ecommerce.customer WHERE level_code = 'SILVER' ORDER BY customer_id;

question: 按会员等级名称统计用户数量。
query: SELECT d.level_name, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM ecommerce.customer c JOIN common.customer_level_dict d ON c.level_code = d.level_code GROUP BY d.level_code, d.level_name ORDER BY d.level_code;

question: 请查询库存低于20的商品库存记录，输出结果。
query: SELECT product_id, warehouse_code, stock_quantity FROM ecommerce.inventory WHERE stock_quantity < 20 ORDER BY product_id, warehouse_code;

question: 请查询销量最高的5个商品。
query: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity FROM ecommerce.order_item oi JOIN ecommerce.product p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY sales_quantity DESC, p.product_id ASC LIMIT 5;

question: 按订单状态名称统计订单数量，返回查询结果。
query: SELECT d.status_name, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ecommerce.orders o JOIN common.order_status_dict d ON o.order_status_code = d.status_code GROUP BY d.status_code, d.status_name ORDER BY d.status_code;

question: 请统计每个用户的订单数量
query: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM ecommerce.customer c LEFT JOIN ecommerce.orders o   ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY c.customer_id;

question: 请帮我按支付方式名称统计支付金额。
query: SELECT d.method_name, ROUND(SUM(p.payment_amount), 2) AS pay_amount FROM ecommerce.payment p JOIN common.payment_method_dict d ON p.payment_method_code = d.method_code GROUP BY d.method_code, d.method_name ORDER BY d.method_code;

question: 请查询销量最高的10个商品。
query: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity FROM ecommerce.order_item oi JOIN ecommerce.product p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY sales_quantity DESC, p.product_id ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 帮我查询应付金额大于500的订单。
query: SELECT order_id, payable_amount FROM ecommerce.orders WHERE payable_amount > 500 ORDER BY order_id;

question: 帮我统计整体退款率。

question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过人数，按总评折算不低于60，且排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过人数，并按通过人数降序取前10。
query: SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN s.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_student_cnt FROM education_2024.course c JOIN education_2024.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY pass_student_cnt DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 统计学期一中在读学生参与的每门课程，其平均总评折算分，返回课程编号、课程名与平均总评，按平均总评降序取前10。
query: SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND(AVG(t.total_score),2) AS avg_total_score FROM education_2024.course c JOIN education_2024.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND s.student_status_code='ACTIVE' GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY avg_total_score DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 统计学期一中每个院系选课人数排名前三的课程，返回院系编号、课程编号与课程名、选课人数，并按院系与选课人数降序排序。
query: WITH course_enroll AS (SELECT c.department_id, c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS active_enroll_cnt FROM education_2024.course c JOIN education_2024.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND s.student_status_code='ACTIVE' GROUP BY c.department_id, c.course_id, c.course_name), ranked AS (SELECT department_id, course_id, course_name, active_enroll_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY active_enroll_cnt DESC, course_id ASC) AS rn FROM course_enroll) SELECT department_id, course_id, course_name, active_enroll_cnt FROM ranked WHERE rn<=3 ORDER BY department_id ASC, active_enroll_cnt DESC, course_id ASC;

question: 统计学期一中每门课程最低总评折算分对应的学生学号，若并列取学号最小，返回课程编号、课程名与学号。
query: WITH per_enroll AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, s.student_no, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, s.student_no), ranked AS (SELECT p.course_id, p.student_no, p.total_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY p.course_id ORDER BY p.total_score ASC, p.student_no ASC) AS rn FROM per_enroll p) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, r.student_no FROM ranked r JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=r.course_id WHERE r.rn=1 ORDER BY c.course_id ASC;

question: 统计学期一中每位在读学生的总评折算总分，返回总评最高学生的学号与总分。
query: WITH per_student AS (SELECT s.student_no, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND s.student_status_code='ACTIVE' GROUP BY s.student_no) SELECT student_no, ROUND(total_score,2) AS total_score FROM per_student ORDER BY total_score DESC, student_no ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60，排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过率，以百分比表示并保留两位小数，按通过率降序取前10。
query: WITH course_tot AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id), course_pass AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN e.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND( (p.pass_cnt / NULLIF(t.total_cnt,0))*100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM course_pass p JOIN course_tot t ON t.course_id=p.course_id JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 统计学期一中得分分项中出现次数最多的分项名称，在平时、期中、期末中出现次数最大，若并列按名称升序，返回分项名称与出现次数。
query: SELECT es.exam_item, COUNT(*) AS item_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY es.exam_item ORDER BY item_cnt DESC, es.exam_item ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 统计学期一中每位学生的平均总评折算分，按其所有选课的总评求平均并排除退课，返回平均总评最高的学生学号与平均分。
query: WITH per_enroll AS (SELECT e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), per_student AS (SELECT s.student_no, AVG(p.total_score) AS avg_total_score FROM per_enroll p JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id=p.student_id GROUP BY s.student_no) SELECT student_no, ROUND(avg_total_score,2) AS avg_total_score FROM per_student ORDER BY avg_total_score DESC, student_no ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过人数，按总评折算不低于60，且排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过人数，并按通过人数降序取前10。
query: SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN s.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_student_cnt FROM education_2025.course c JOIN education_2025.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY pass_student_cnt DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 统计学期一中在读学生参与的每门课程，其平均总评折算分，返回课程编号、课程名与平均总评，按平均总评降序取前10。
query: SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND(AVG(t.total_score),2) AS avg_total_score FROM education_2025.course c JOIN education_2025.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND s.student_status_code='ACTIVE' GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY avg_total_score DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 统计学期一中每个院系选课人数排名前三的课程，返回院系编号、课程编号与课程名、选课人数，并按院系与选课人数降序排序。
query: WITH course_enroll AS (SELECT c.department_id, c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS active_enroll_cnt FROM education_2025.course c JOIN education_2025.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND s.student_status_code='ACTIVE' GROUP BY c.department_id, c.course_id, c.course_name), ranked AS (SELECT department_id, course_id, course_name, active_enroll_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY active_enroll_cnt DESC, course_id ASC) AS rn FROM course_enroll) SELECT department_id, course_id, course_name, active_enroll_cnt FROM ranked WHERE rn<=3 ORDER BY department_id ASC, active_enroll_cnt DESC, course_id ASC;

question: 统计学期一中每门课程最低总评折算分对应的学生学号，若并列取学号最小，返回课程编号、课程名与学号。
query: WITH per_enroll AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, s.student_no, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, s.student_no), ranked AS (SELECT p.course_id, p.student_no, p.total_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY p.course_id ORDER BY p.total_score ASC, p.student_no ASC) AS rn FROM per_enroll p) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, r.student_no FROM ranked r JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=r.course_id WHERE r.rn=1 ORDER BY c.course_id ASC;

question: 统计学期一中每位在读学生的总评折算总分，返回总评最高学生的学号与总分。
query: WITH per_student AS (SELECT s.student_no, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND s.student_status_code='ACTIVE' GROUP BY s.student_no) SELECT student_no, ROUND(total_score,2) AS total_score FROM per_student ORDER BY total_score DESC, student_no ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 查询课程表中学分平均是否大于等于3，并返回平均学分。

question: 统计学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60，排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与通过率，以百分比表示并保留两位小数，按通过率降序取前10。
query: WITH course_tot AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id), course_pass AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN e.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN (SELECT es.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.exam_score es GROUP BY es.enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND( (p.pass_cnt / NULLIF(t.total_cnt,0))*100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM course_pass p JOIN course_tot t ON t.course_id=p.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 统计学期一中得分分项中出现次数最多的分项名称，在平时、期中、期末中出现次数最大，若并列按名称升序，返回分项名称与出现次数。
query: SELECT es.exam_item, COUNT(*) AS item_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY es.exam_item ORDER BY item_cnt DESC, es.exam_item ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 统计学期一中每位学生的平均总评折算分，按其所有选课的总评求平均并排除退课，返回平均总评最高的学生学号与平均分。
query: WITH per_enroll AS (SELECT e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), per_student AS (SELECT s.student_no, AVG(p.total_score) AS avg_total_score FROM per_enroll p JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id=p.student_id GROUP BY s.student_no) SELECT student_no, ROUND(avg_total_score,2) AS avg_total_score FROM per_student ORDER BY avg_total_score DESC, student_no ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 统计学期一中每门课程的平均考试总评，对无成绩的选课按0计，返回课程编号、课程名与平均总评，按平均总评降序取前10。
query: WITH per_enroll AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e LEFT JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND(AVG(p.total_score),2) AS avg_total_score FROM per_enroll p JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY avg_total_score DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 统计学期一中每位在读学生的及格课程数，通过总评不低于60且排除退课，返回学生学号与及格课程数，按及格课程数降序取前10。
query: WITH per_enroll AS (SELECT e.student_id, e.course_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.student_id, e.course_id) SELECT s.student_no, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.total_score>=60 THEN p.course_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_course_cnt FROM per_enroll p JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id=p.student_id WHERE s.student_status_code='ACTIVE' GROUP BY s.student_no ORDER BY pass_course_cnt DESC, s.student_no ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 统计学期一中每个院系选课人数排名前二的院系，返回院系编号与选课人数，去重学生，按选课人数降序取前2。

query: WITH per_enroll AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id ) SELECT class_id, ROUND(AVG(total_score), 2) AS avg_total_score FROM per_enroll WHERE class_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY class_id ORDER BY avg_total_score DESC, class_id ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 查询学期代码以“2025”开头的学期数量，并返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS semester_code_start_2025_cnt FROM education_2025.semester sem WHERE sem.semester_code LIKE '2025%';

question: 查询学期一中各课程的最高总评折算分不低于90的课程数量，并返回数量。
query: WITH per_student AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id ), per_course_max AS ( SELECT course_id, MAX(total_score) AS max_total_score FROM per_student GROUP BY course_id ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS course_cnt_with_max_total_score_ge_90 FROM per_course_max WHERE max_total_score >= 90;

question: 查询教师表中电话不为空的教师数量，并返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS teacher_phone_not_empty_cnt FROM education_2025.teacher t WHERE t.phone IS NOT NULL AND t.phone<>'';

question: 统计学期一中每门课程的及格人数，总评不低于60并排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与及格人数，按及格人数降序取前10。
query: WITH per_enroll AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, e.student_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.total_score>=60 THEN p.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_student_cnt FROM per_enroll p JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY pass_student_cnt DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 查询课程表中课程名以“管”结尾的课程数量，并返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS course_name_end_with_guan_cnt FROM education_2025.course c WHERE c.course_name LIKE '%管';

question: 查询学期二中选课人数排名第一的课程，返回课程编号、课程名与选课人数，去重学生，排除退课。
query: SELECT x.course_id, x.course_name, x.active_enroll_student_cnt FROM (SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS active_enroll_student_cnt FROM education_2025.course c JOIN education_2025.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name) x ORDER BY x.active_enroll_student_cnt DESC, x.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 查询在读学生中性别为女性的数量，并返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_active_student_cnt FROM education_2025.student s WHERE s.student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND s.gender_code='F';

question: 查询学期表中结束日期键最大的学期代码，返回学期代码。
query: SELECT sem.semester_code FROM education_2025.semester sem ORDER BY sem.end_date_key DESC, sem.semester_code ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 统计学期一中每门课程的总评折算分中位数，返回课程编号、课程名与中位总评。
