query: WITH per_enroll AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), ranked AS (SELECT p.course_id, p.total_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY p.course_id ORDER BY p.total_score ASC) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY p.course_id) AS cnt FROM per_enroll p), median_pick AS (SELECT course_id, total_score FROM ranked WHERE rn=FLOOR((cnt+1)/2) OR rn=CEIL((cnt+1)/2)) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND(AVG(m.total_score),2) AS median_total_score FROM median_pick m JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=m.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY c.course_id ASC;

question: 查询班级表中院系编号为3且入学年为2023的班级数量，并返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS class_cnt_dept3_grade2023 FROM education_2025.class cl WHERE cl.department_id=3 AND cl.grade_year=2023;

question: 查询学期一中所有课程的学生平均总评折算分，并返回平均值最高的排名第一的课程，排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与平均分。
query: WITH per_enroll AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), per_course AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_score FROM per_enroll GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND(pc.avg_total_score,2) AS avg_total_score FROM per_course pc JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=pc.course_id ORDER BY pc.avg_total_score DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 查询课程表里学分为1的课程数量，并返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS course_credit_1_cnt FROM education_2025.course c WHERE c.credit=1;

question: 查询学期二中每个班级的及格率，通过总评不低于60并排除退课，返回班级编号与及格率百分比，保留两位小数，按及格率降序取前10。
query: WITH per_enroll AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, e.student_id ), per_class AS ( SELECT class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_student_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_student_cnt FROM per_enroll GROUP BY class_id ) SELECT class_id, ROUND((pass_student_cnt / NULLIF(total_student_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM per_class WHERE class_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, class_id ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 查询院系编号为4的学生数量，并返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS student_cnt_dept4 FROM education_2025.student s WHERE s.department_id=4;

question: 查询课程表里是否存在课程名为“高等数学”的课程，若存在返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS course_name_eq_gaodeng_shux_cnt FROM education_2025.course c WHERE c.course_name='高等数学';

question: 统计学期一中各课程的报名学生去重人数中，人数最少的排名第一的课程，返回课程编号、课程名与人数。
query: WITH course_enroll AS (SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS active_enroll_student_cnt FROM education_2025.course c JOIN education_2025.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name) SELECT course_id, course_name, active_enroll_student_cnt FROM course_enroll ORDER BY active_enroll_student_cnt ASC, course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 查询学期一中每位学生的最高单门总评折算分，返回学号与最高分，按最高分降序取前10。
query: WITH per_course_score AS (SELECT e.student_id, c.course_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.student_id, c.course_id) SELECT s.student_no, ROUND(MAX(p.total_score),2) AS max_total_score FROM per_course_score p JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id=p.student_id GROUP BY s.student_no ORDER BY max_total_score DESC, s.student_no ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 查询课程表中课程编号大于等于100的课程数量，并返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS course_id_ge_100_cnt FROM education_2025.course c WHERE c.course_id>=100;

question: 查询学期二中退课记录数，并返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS withdraw_enrollment_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=2 AND e.is_withdraw=1;

question: 查询学期一中每个院系的平均课程学分，按该院系的课程取平均，返回院系与平均学分，按平均学分降序取前10。
query: SELECT c.department_id, ROUND(AVG(c.credit),2) AS avg_course_credit FROM education_2025.course c GROUP BY c.department_id ORDER BY avg_course_credit DESC, c.department_id ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 查询在读学生中性别为男的数量，并返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_active_student_cnt FROM education_2025.student s WHERE s.student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND s.gender_code='M';

question: 查询课程表中学分为3或4的课程数量，并返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS course_credit_3_or_4_cnt FROM education_2025.course c WHERE c.credit IN (3,4);

question: 统计学期一中每门课程的及格率，并返回及格率最低的排名第一的课程，通过总评不低于60并排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与及格率百分比。
query: WITH student_score AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id ), course_tot AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 AND is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY course_id ), course_pass AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM student_score GROUP BY course_id ) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p.pass_cnt / NULLIF(t.total_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM course_pass p JOIN course_tot t ON t.course_id = p.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct ASC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 比较2024与2025两年课程表的总课程数，返回2024与2025各自的课程数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_cnt FROM education_2024.course UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_cnt FROM education_2025.course;

question: 比较2024与2025学期表的学期数量，返回2024与2025各自的学期数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS semester_cnt FROM education_2024.semester UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS semester_cnt FROM education_2025.semester;

question: 比较2024与2025在读学生数量，返回2024与2025各自的在读学生数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_student_cnt FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_student_cnt FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE';

question: 比较2024与2025课程平均学分，返回2024平均学分与2025平均学分，保留两位小数。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, ROUND(AVG(credit),2) AS avg_credit FROM education_2024.course UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, ROUND(AVG(credit),2) AS avg_credit FROM education_2025.course;

question: 比较2024与2025教师表电话非空数量，返回2024与2025各自数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_phone_not_empty_cnt FROM education_2024.teacher WHERE phone IS NOT NULL AND phone<>'' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_phone_not_empty_cnt FROM education_2025.teacher WHERE phone IS NOT NULL AND phone<>'';

question: 找出2024与2025两年中在读学生里性别为女性的数量差，即2025年减去2024年，返回差值与两年各自女性在读人数。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_active_2024 FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND gender_code='F'), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_active_2025 FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND gender_code='F') SELECT (female_active_2025 - female_active_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, female_active_2024, female_active_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较两年中同学期即学期编号为1的退课学生数是否变化，返回2024退课人数与2025退课人数。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_student_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_student_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1;

question: 对比2024与2025学期一中每门课程选课人数，排除退课并去重学生，返回两年课程编号、课程名与两年选课人数。
query: WITH e2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_student_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id), e2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_student_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id) SELECT COALESCE(e2024.course_id,e2025.course_id) AS course_id, c.course_name, e2024.enroll_student_cnt_2024, e2025.enroll_student_cnt_2025 FROM e2024 LEFT JOIN e2025 ON e2025.course_id=e2024.course_id LEFT JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=COALESCE(e2024.course_id,e2025.course_id) UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(e2024.course_id,e2025.course_id) AS course_id, c.course_name, e2024.enroll_student_cnt_2024, e2025.enroll_student_cnt_2025 FROM e2025 LEFT JOIN e2024 ON e2024.course_id=e2025.course_id LEFT JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=COALESCE(e2024.course_id,e2025.course_id) LIMIT 30;

question: 计算2024与2025中课程学分为3的数量差，即2025年减去2024年，返回差值及两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course WHERE credit=3), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course WHERE credit=3) SELECT (b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 找出2024与2025中课程名包含“数据库”的课程，在两年里是否都存在，返回课程名、2024是否存在、2025是否存在。
query: WITH c2024 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT course_id, course_name FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_name LIKE '%数据库%' ), c2025 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT course_id, course_name FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_name LIKE '%数据库%' ) SELECT COALESCE(a.course_id, b.course_id) AS course_id, COALESCE(a.course_name, b.course_name) AS course_name, CASE WHEN a.course_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_in_2024, CASE WHEN b.course_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_in_2025 FROM c2024 a LEFT JOIN c2025 b ON b.course_id = a.course_id UNION SELECT COALESCE(a.course_id, b.course_id) AS course_id, COALESCE(a.course_name, b.course_name) AS course_name, CASE WHEN a.course_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_in_2024, CASE WHEN b.course_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_in_2025 FROM c2024 a RIGHT JOIN c2025 b ON b.course_id = a.course_id WHERE a.course_id IS NULL;

question: 比较2024与2025教师表按院系编号统计的教师数量，返回院系编号、两年教师数，并按2025教师数降序取前15。
query: WITH t2024 AS (SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS teacher_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.teacher GROUP BY department_id), t2025 AS (SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS teacher_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.teacher GROUP BY department_id) SELECT COALESCE(t2024.department_id,t2025.department_id) AS department_id, t2024.teacher_cnt_2024, t2025.teacher_cnt_2025 FROM t2024 JOIN t2025 ON t2025.department_id=t2024.department_id ORDER BY t2025.teacher_cnt_2025 DESC, department_id ASC LIMIT 15;

question: 对比2024与2025学期一中每门课程的通过率，通过总评不低于60并排除退课，返回两年通过率最高的排名第一的课程，包含课程编号、课程名、两年通过率。
query: WITH score2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2024 GROUP BY course_id), score2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每个班级的及格率，总评不低于60并排除退课，返回及格率在2025上升最多的班级，按2025减2024差值降序取前1。
query: WITH s2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id ), a2024 AS ( SELECT class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM s2024 GROUP BY class_id ), s2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.student_id, e.enrollment_id ), a2025 AS ( SELECT class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM s2025 GROUP BY class_id ) SELECT a2025.class_id, ROUND(((a2025.pass_cnt / NULLIF(a2025.total_cnt, 0)) - (a2024.pass_cnt / NULLIF(a2024.total_cnt, 0))) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_diff_pct, ROUND((a2024.pass_cnt / NULLIF(a2024.total_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct, ROUND((a2025.pass_cnt / NULLIF(a2025.total_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct FROM a2025 JOIN a2024 ON a2024.class_id = a2025.class_id ORDER BY pass_rate_diff_pct DESC, a2025.class_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 找出2024与2025两年中学号一致的学生中，2025在读而2024不在读的学生数量。
query: WITH s2024 AS (SELECT student_id FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE'), s2025 AS (SELECT student_id FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE') SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_in_2025_but_not_2024_cnt FROM s2025 LEFT JOIN s2024 ON s2024.student_id=s2025.student_id WHERE s2024.student_id IS NULL;

question: 统计2024与2025两年在同一课程编号上选课且都为同一学号的学生数差，返回每门课程两年共同学生数与仅2025学生数。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT course_id, student_id FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE is_withdraw=0), b AS (SELECT course_id, student_id FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE is_withdraw=0) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.student_id) AS both_2024_2025_student_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.student_id IS NOT NULL AND a.student_id IS NULL THEN b.student_id ELSE NULL END) AS only_2025_student_cnt FROM education_2025.course c LEFT JOIN b ON b.course_id=c.course_id LEFT JOIN a ON a.course_id=c.course_id AND a.student_id=b.student_id GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY both_2024_2025_student_cnt DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 15;

question: 判断2024与2025课程表中是否存在学分为0的课程，分别返回数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS credit_zero_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE credit=0 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS credit_zero_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE credit=0;

question: 比较2024与2025教师电话为空或空字符串的数量，返回两年各自数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_phone_empty_cnt FROM education_2024.teacher WHERE phone IS NULL OR phone='' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_phone_empty_cnt FROM education_2025.teacher WHERE phone IS NULL OR phone='';

question: 找出2024与2025中院系编号为1的学生在读数量差，即2025年减去2024年，返回差值及两年在读人数。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND department_id=1), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND department_id=1) SELECT (b.active_cnt_2025-a.active_cnt_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.active_cnt_2024, b.active_cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025课程学分不低于5的课程平均学分，并返回两年结果。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, ROUND(AVG(credit),2) AS avg_credit_ge_5 FROM education_2024.course WHERE credit>=3 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, ROUND(AVG(credit),2) AS avg_credit_ge_5 FROM education_2025.course WHERE credit>=3;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每门课程的参与人数，排除退课并去重学生，并返回参与人数在2025增加最多的排名第一的课程，差值等于2025减2024。
query: WITH p2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id), p2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, (COALESCE(p2025.cnt_2025,0)-COALESCE(p2024.cnt_2024,0)) AS diff_participation_cnt, COALESCE(p2024.cnt_2024,0) AS cnt_2024, COALESCE(p2025.cnt_2025,0) AS cnt_2025 FROM p2025 LEFT JOIN p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id LEFT JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY diff_participation_cnt DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 找出2024与2025两年中学籍状态代码不同的学生，返回两年状态不相同的学生数量，按学号。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS status_changed_cnt FROM education_2024.student a JOIN education_2025.student b ON b.student_id=a.student_id WHERE a.student_status_code<>b.student_status_code;

question: 比较2024与2025学生性别为女性的比例，即女性数除以总数，返回两年比例，以百分比表示并保留两位小数。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN gender_code='F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0))*100,2) AS female_rate_pct FROM education_2024.student UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN gender_code='F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0))*100,2) AS female_rate_pct FROM education_2025.student;

question: 统计2024与2025两年中起始日期键不低于20240101的学期中各自有效选课记录数，排除退课，返回两年有效选课记录数。
query: WITH sem2024 AS (SELECT semester_id FROM education_2024.semester WHERE start_date_key>=20240101), sem2025 AS (SELECT semester_id FROM education_2025.semester WHERE start_date_key>=20240101) SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_enroll_record_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.is_withdraw=0 AND e.semester_id IN (SELECT semester_id FROM sem2024) UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_enroll_record_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.is_withdraw=0 AND e.semester_id IN (SELECT semester_id FROM sem2025);

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程类型为“必修”的数量差，即2025年减去2024年，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS compulsory_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_type='必修'), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS compulsory_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_type='必修') SELECT (b.compulsory_cnt_2025-a.compulsory_cnt_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.compulsory_cnt_2024, b.compulsory_cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 找出2024与2025中在同一课程上选课，学期编号为1且排除退课，且总评不低于60的学生数差，即2025年减去2024年，按课程返回前10。
query: WITH per2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS pass_cnt_2024 FROM per2024 WHERE total_score>=30 GROUP BY course_id), per2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS pass_cnt_2025 FROM per2025 WHERE total_score>=30 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COALESCE(agg2025.pass_cnt_2025,0)-COALESCE(agg2024.pass_cnt_2024,0) AS pass_cnt_diff_2025_minus_2024, COALESCE(agg2024.pass_cnt_2024,0) AS pass_cnt_2024, COALESCE(agg2025.pass_cnt_2025,0) AS pass_cnt_2025 FROM agg2025 LEFT JOIN agg2024 ON agg2024.course_id=agg2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=agg2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_cnt_diff_2025_minus_2024 DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程编号最小值与最大值，返回两年最小值与最大值。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, MIN(course_id) AS min_course_id, MAX(course_id) AS max_course_id FROM education_2024.course UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, MIN(course_id) AS min_course_id, MAX(course_id) AS max_course_id FROM education_2025.course;

question: 比较2024与2025教师工号在两年都存在的数量，返回两年共同教师工号数。
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.teacher_no) AS common_teacher_no_cnt FROM education_2024.teacher a JOIN education_2025.teacher b ON b.teacher_no=a.teacher_no;

question: 找出2024与2025中同名课程，即课程名相同但学分不同的课程数量，并返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS course_name_diff_credit_cnt FROM (SELECT a.course_name, a.credit AS credit_2024, b.credit AS credit_2025 FROM education_2024.course a JOIN education_2025.course b ON b.course_name=a.course_name WHERE a.credit<>b.credit) t;

question: 统计2024与2025学期一中课程选择人数差，即2025减2024，差值最大的前5门课程，去重学生并排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与差值。
query: WITH p2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id), p2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COALESCE(p2025.cnt_2025,0)-COALESCE(p2024.cnt_2024,0) AS diff_cnt_2025_minus_2024 FROM p2025 LEFT JOIN p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY diff_cnt_2025_minus_2024 DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 5;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二每位学生的平均总评折算分，排除退课，返回两年各自平均值，保留两位小数。
query: WITH per2024 AS (SELECT e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), avg2024 AS (SELECT AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_score_2024 FROM per2024), per2025 AS (SELECT e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), avg2025 AS (SELECT AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_score_2025 FROM per2025) SELECT ROUND(avg_total_score_2024,2) AS avg_total_score_2024, ROUND(avg_total_score_2025,2) AS avg_total_score_2025 FROM avg2024 CROSS JOIN avg2025;

question: 查询2024与2025中课程类型为“选修”的课程数量，并返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS elective_course_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_type='选修' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS elective_course_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_type='选修';

question: 统计2024与2025学期一中每门课程平均总评折算分，并返回差值，即2025减2024，最大的前10门课程。
query: WITH per2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), a2024 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2024 FROM per2024 GROUP BY course_id), per2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), a2025 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2025 FROM per2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, (COALESCE(a2025.avg_total_2025,0)-COALESCE(a2024.avg_total_2024,0)) AS diff_avg_total_score_2025_minus_2024, a2024.avg_total_2024, a2025.avg_total_2025 FROM a2025 LEFT JOIN a2024 ON a2024.course_id=a2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=a2025.course_id ORDER BY diff_avg_total_score_2025_minus_2024 DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 找出2024与2025中共同选修的学生，学期编号为1并排除退课，2025中总评最低的排名第一的学生，按两年共同课程计算总评相加不低于实际，返回学号与两年总评。
query: WITH per2024 AS ( SELECT e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.student_id ), per2025 AS ( SELECT e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.student_id ), common_students AS ( SELECT p24.student_id, p24.total_score_2024, p25.total_score_2025 FROM per2024 p24 JOIN per2025 p25 ON p25.student_id = p24.student_id ) SELECT s.student_no, ROUND(c.total_score_2024, 2) AS total_score_2024, ROUND(c.total_score_2025, 2) AS total_score_2025 FROM common_students c JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = c.student_id ORDER BY c.total_score_2025 ASC, s.student_no ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 比较2024与2025学期表中学期代码包含“2024”的数量，并返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS semester_code_like_2024_cnt FROM education_2024.semester WHERE semester_code LIKE '%2024%' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS semester_code_like_2024_cnt FROM education_2025.semester WHERE semester_code LIKE '%2024%';

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中课程编号为1的选课人数，排除退课并去重学生，返回两年人数。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_student_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 AND course_id=1 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_student_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 AND course_id=1;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中退课人数，退课标记为1并去重学生，返回两年人数及差值，即2025减2024。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_student_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=2 AND is_withdraw=1), b AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_student_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=2 AND is_withdraw=1) SELECT (b.withdraw_student_cnt_2025-a.withdraw_student_cnt_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.withdraw_student_cnt_2024, b.withdraw_student_cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 找出2024与2025两年中学生平均家庭地区编号，对在读学生，并返回两年均值，保留两位小数。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, ROUND(AVG(home_region_id),2) AS avg_home_region_id FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, ROUND(AVG(home_region_id),2) AS avg_home_region_id FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE';

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每门课程的退课人数，这里统计退课标记为1，返回前10门课程的两年退课人数。
query: WITH w2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_student_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1 GROUP BY course_id), w2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_student_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COALESCE(w2024.withdraw_student_cnt_2024,0) AS withdraw_student_cnt_2024, COALESCE(w2025.withdraw_student_cnt_2025,0) AS withdraw_student_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course c LEFT JOIN w2025 ON w2025.course_id=c.course_id LEFT JOIN w2024 ON w2024.course_id=c.course_id ORDER BY COALESCE(w2025.withdraw_student_cnt_2025,0) DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程名以“数”开头的数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_start_num_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_name LIKE '数%' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_start_num_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_name LIKE '数%';

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中学分为偶数的课程数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS even_credit_course_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course WHERE MOD(credit,2)=0), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS even_credit_course_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course WHERE MOD(credit,2)=0) SELECT (b.even_credit_course_cnt_2025-a.even_credit_course_cnt_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.even_credit_course_cnt_2024, b.even_credit_course_cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 找出2024与2025两年中学生学号的集合差，返回仅存在于2024但不在2025的学号数量，按学号。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS only_2024_not_2025_student_cnt FROM education_2024.student a LEFT JOIN education_2025.student b ON b.student_id=a.student_id WHERE b.student_id IS NULL;

question: 找出2024与2025两年共同存在的学生中，家庭地区编号在两年发生变化的学生数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.student_id) AS home_region_changed_cnt FROM education_2024.student a JOIN education_2025.student b ON b.student_id=a.student_id WHERE COALESCE(a.home_region_id,-1)<>COALESCE(b.home_region_id,-1);

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每门课程最高总评折算分的课程，返回两年都存在且最高分相等的课程数量。
query: WITH max2024 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id ), agg2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, MAX(total_score) AS max_total_2024 FROM max2024 GROUP BY course_id ), max2025 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id ), agg2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, MAX(total_score) AS max_total_2025 FROM max2025 GROUP BY course_id ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS courses_max_equal_cnt FROM agg2024 a JOIN agg2025 b ON b.course_id = a.course_id WHERE a.max_total_2024 = b.max_total_2025;

question: 比较2024与2025教师工号的数量，不去重并按记录数，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_record_cnt FROM education_2024.teacher UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_record_cnt FROM education_2025.teacher;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中各课程的选课学生平均总评折算分，排除退课，返回两年各课程的平均分对比前10，按2025平均分降序。
query: WITH s2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), a2024 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2024 FROM s2024 GROUP BY course_id), s2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), a2025 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2025 FROM s2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND(a2024.avg_total_2024,2) AS avg_total_2024, ROUND(a2025.avg_total_2025,2) AS avg_total_2025 FROM a2025 LEFT JOIN a2024 ON a2024.course_id=a2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=a2025.course_id ORDER BY avg_total_2025 DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 统计2024与2025课程表中课程名相同的课程对数中，有多少对的学分不同，按课程名。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS course_name_pairs_credit_diff_cnt FROM (SELECT a.course_name FROM education_2024.course a JOIN education_2025.course b ON b.course_name=a.course_name WHERE a.credit<>b.credit GROUP BY a.course_name) t;

question: 比较2024与2025学生表中学号前缀为2023的在读学生数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_student_no_prefix_2023_cnt FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND student_no LIKE '2023%' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_student_no_prefix_2023_cnt FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND student_no LIKE '2023%';

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中课程类型为必修的课程中，及格率最高的排名第一的课程，返回课程编号、课程名、两年及格率。
query: WITH pass2024 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 AND c.course_type = '必修' GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id ), agg2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt FROM pass2024 GROUP BY course_id ), pass2025 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 AND c.course_type = '必修' GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id ), agg2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt FROM pass2025 GROUP BY course_id ) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt / NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((p2024.pass_cnt / NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct FROM agg2025 p2025 JOIN agg2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id = p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = p2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_2025_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 比较2024与2025学期表中起始日期键的最小值与最大值，返回两年最小值与最大值。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, MIN(start_date_key) AS min_start_date_key, MAX(start_date_key) AS max_start_date_key FROM education_2024.semester UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, MIN(start_date_key) AS min_start_date_key, MAX(start_date_key) AS max_start_date_key FROM education_2025.semester;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每个院系的平均选课学生数，按院系的课程汇总的选课人数均值，排除退课，返回两年院系平均选课人数前5，按2025均值降序。
query: WITH e2024 AS (SELECT c.department_id, e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.department_id, e.course_id), a2024 AS (SELECT department_id, AVG(enroll_cnt_2024) AS avg_enroll_per_course_2024 FROM e2024 GROUP BY department_id), e2025 AS (SELECT c.department_id, e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.department_id, e.course_id), a2025 AS (SELECT department_id, AVG(enroll_cnt_2025) AS avg_enroll_per_course_2025 FROM e2025 GROUP BY department_id) SELECT COALESCE(a2024.department_id,a2025.department_id) AS department_id, ROUND(a2024.avg_enroll_per_course_2024,2) AS avg_enroll_per_course_2024, ROUND(a2025.avg_enroll_per_course_2025,2) AS avg_enroll_per_course_2025 FROM a2025 LEFT JOIN a2024 ON a2024.department_id=a2025.department_id ORDER BY avg_enroll_per_course_2025 DESC, department_id ASC LIMIT 5;

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中电话去重后的数量，返回两年各自的去重电话数。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT phone) AS distinct_phone_cnt FROM education_2024.teacher WHERE phone IS NOT NULL AND phone<>'' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT phone) AS distinct_phone_cnt FROM education_2025.teacher WHERE phone IS NOT NULL AND phone<>'';

question: 找出2024与2025两年中学期表里是否存在学期代码相同的记录，返回学期代码、2024是否存在、2025是否存在。
query: SELECT COALESCE(a.semester_code,b.semester_code) AS semester_code, CASE WHEN a.semester_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_in_2024, CASE WHEN b.semester_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exists_in_2025 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester) a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester) b ON b.semester_code=a.semester_code UNION SELECT b.semester_code, 0 AS exists_in_2024, 1 AS exists_in_2025 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester) b LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester) a ON a.semester_code=b.semester_code WHERE a.semester_code IS NULL;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表学分不低于6的课程数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值及两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course WHERE credit>=6), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course WHERE credit>=6) SELECT (b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025在读学生数量，学籍状态为在读，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_student_cnt FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_student_cnt FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE';

question: 比较2024与2025中性别为男性的在读学生数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_active_2024 FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND gender_code='M'), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_active_2025 FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND gender_code='M') SELECT (b.male_active_2025-a.male_active_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.male_active_2024, b.male_active_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 找出2024与2025两年中同一课程编号在学期一中平均总评折算分的差值前5，即2025减2024并排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名、两年平均与差值。
query: WITH per2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), a2024 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2024 FROM per2024 GROUP BY course_id), per2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), a2025 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2025 FROM per2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND(a2024.avg_total_2024,2) AS avg_total_2024, ROUND(a2025.avg_total_2025,2) AS avg_total_2025, ROUND((a2025.avg_total_2025-a2024.avg_total_2024),2) AS diff_avg_total_score_2025_minus_2024 FROM a2025 JOIN a2024 ON a2024.course_id=a2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=a2025.course_id ORDER BY diff_avg_total_score_2025_minus_2024 DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 5;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程类型分别为必修的数量，返回两年各自数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS compulsory_course_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_type='必修' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS compulsory_course_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_type='必修';

question: 比较2024与2025学期表里起始日期键为空或为0的学期记录数，返回两年各自数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS semester_start_key_empty_or_zero_cnt FROM education_2024.semester WHERE start_date_key IS NULL OR start_date_key=0 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS semester_start_key_empty_or_zero_cnt FROM education_2025.semester WHERE start_date_key IS NULL OR start_date_key=0;

question: 找出2024与2025学期二中退课最多的课程，此处统计退课标记为1并去重学生，返回两年各自退课第一名的课程编号与退课人数。
query: (SELECT '2024' AS year, e.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS withdraw_student_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 1 GROUP BY e.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY withdraw_student_cnt DESC, e.course_id ASC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT '2025' AS year, e.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS withdraw_student_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 1 GROUP BY e.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY withdraw_student_cnt DESC, e.course_id ASC LIMIT 1);

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每位学生参加课程的平均课程数，排除退课并按学号统计选课去重，返回两年平均课程数。
query: WITH p2024 AS (SELECT student_id, COUNT(DISTINCT course_id) AS course_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY student_id), a2024 AS (SELECT AVG(course_cnt) AS avg_course_cnt FROM p2024), p2025 AS (SELECT student_id, COUNT(DISTINCT course_id) AS course_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY student_id), a2025 AS (SELECT AVG(course_cnt) AS avg_course_cnt FROM p2025) SELECT ROUND(a2024.avg_course_cnt,2) AS avg_course_cnt_2024, ROUND(a2025.avg_course_cnt,2) AS avg_course_cnt_2025 FROM a2024 CROSS JOIN a2025;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中学分为1的课程数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_credit_1_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE credit=1 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_credit_1_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE credit=1;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每个班级的平均总评折算分，排除退课，返回平均分最高的班级在两年中的差值，即2025减2024，取班级编号相同者。
query: WITH s2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id ), a2024 AS ( SELECT class_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2024 FROM s2024 GROUP BY class_id ), s2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id ), a2025 AS ( SELECT class_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2025 FROM s2025 GROUP BY class_id ) SELECT a2025.class_id, ROUND(a2024.avg_total_2024, 2) AS avg_total_2024, ROUND(a2025.avg_total_2025, 2) AS avg_total_2025, ROUND(a2025.avg_total_2025 - a2024.avg_total_2024, 2) AS diff_avg_total_2025_minus_2024 FROM a2025 JOIN a2024 ON a2024.class_id = a2025.class_id ORDER BY diff_avg_total_2025_minus_2024 DESC, a2025.class_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 比较2024与2025在读学生中家庭地区编号为1的学生比例，即家庭地区编号为1除以总在读数，返回两年百分比。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN home_region_id=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)*100,2) AS region1_active_rate_pct FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN home_region_id=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)*100,2) AS region1_active_rate_pct FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE';

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中课程类型为“必修”的选课人数，排除退课，并返回两年总人数。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, SUM(cnt) AS enroll_student_cnt FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND c.course_type='必修' GROUP BY e.course_id) t UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, SUM(cnt) AS enroll_student_cnt FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND c.course_type='必修' GROUP BY e.course_id) t;

question: 比较2024与2025教师姓名以“李”开头的教师数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_name_like_li_cnt FROM education_2024.teacher WHERE teacher_name LIKE '李%' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_name_like_li_cnt FROM education_2025.teacher WHERE teacher_name LIKE '李%';

question: 找出2024与2025两年课程表中课程名相同但学分不同的课程名数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS course_name_same_but_credit_diff_cnt FROM (SELECT a.course_name FROM education_2024.course a JOIN education_2025.course b ON b.course_name=a.course_name WHERE a.credit<>b.credit GROUP BY a.course_name) t;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每门课程最高总评折算分的课程前3，各自前3，然后把两年的结果合并并标注年份，返回最多6行。
query: (WITH per2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), max2024 AS (SELECT course_id, MAX(total_score) AS max_total FROM per2024 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT '2024' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND(m.max_total,2) AS max_total_score FROM max2024 m JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=m.course_id ORDER BY max_total_score DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 3) UNION ALL (WITH per2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), max2025 AS (SELECT course_id, MAX(total_score) AS max_total FROM per2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT '2025' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND(m.max_total,2) AS max_total_score FROM max2025 m JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=m.course_id ORDER BY max_total_score DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 3);

question: 比较2024与2025学期表中学期代码相等的数量，学期代码非空且不为0，返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS common_semester_code_cnt FROM (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester WHERE semester_code IS NOT NULL AND semester_code<>'' AND semester_code<>'0') a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester WHERE semester_code IS NOT NULL AND semester_code<>'' AND semester_code<>'0') b ON b.semester_code=a.semester_code;

question: 统计2024与2025学期表中结束日期键最大的10个学期代码在两年是否都存在，返回在两年都存在的数量。
query: WITH top2024 AS (SELECT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester WHERE semester_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY end_date_key DESC, semester_code ASC LIMIT 10), top2025 AS (SELECT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester WHERE semester_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY end_date_key DESC, semester_code ASC LIMIT 10) SELECT COUNT(*) AS common_top10_end_date_semester_code_cnt FROM top2024 a JOIN top2025 b ON b.semester_code=a.semester_code;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每个学生的平均总评折算分，排除退课，并返回两年整体平均折算分，即所有学生平均的平均。
query: WITH per2024 AS (SELECT e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), avg_by_student_2024 AS (SELECT AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_by_student_2024 FROM per2024), per2025 AS (SELECT e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), avg_by_student_2025 AS (SELECT AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_by_student_2025 FROM per2025) SELECT ROUND(avg_total_by_student_2024,2) AS avg_total_by_student_2024, ROUND(avg_total_by_student_2025,2) AS avg_total_by_student_2025 FROM avg_by_student_2024 CROSS JOIN avg_by_student_2025;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中学分为0的课程数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS credit_zero_course_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE credit=0 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS credit_zero_course_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE credit=0;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程退课率，退课学生除以选课学生，均去重学生，返回退课率最高的课程在两年中的差值第一名，即2025减2024。
query: WITH base2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, MAX(e.is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS total_student_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdraw_student_cnt FROM base2024 GROUP BY course_id), base2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, MAX(e.is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS total_student_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdraw_student_cnt FROM base2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((a2025.withdraw_student_cnt/NULLIF(a2025.total_student_cnt,0))*100,2) AS withdraw_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((a2024.withdraw_student_cnt/NULLIF(a2024.total_student_cnt,0))*100,2) AS withdraw_rate_2024_pct, ROUND(((a2025.withdraw_student_cnt/NULLIF(a2025.total_student_cnt,0))-(a2024.withdraw_student_cnt/NULLIF(a2024.total_student_cnt,0)))*100,2) AS withdraw_rate_diff_pct FROM agg2025 a2025 JOIN agg2024 a2024 ON a2024.course_id=a2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=a2025.course_id ORDER BY withdraw_rate_diff_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中电话不为空且不为空字符串的比例，非空数量除以教师总数，返回两年百分比。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN phone IS NOT NULL AND phone<>'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)*100,2) AS phone_non_empty_rate_pct FROM education_2024.teacher UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN phone IS NOT NULL AND phone<>'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)*100,2) AS phone_non_empty_rate_pct FROM education_2025.teacher;

question: 找出2024与2025两年中同一班级编号对应的课程平均学分差，对该班级选修课程学分的平均并排除退课，返回班级编号与学分差前10，即2025减2024。
query: WITH per2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.course_id, c.credit FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = e.course_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 ), a2024 AS ( SELECT class_id, AVG(credit) AS avg_credit_2024 FROM per2024 GROUP BY class_id ), per2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.course_id, c.credit FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = e.course_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 ), a2025 AS ( SELECT class_id, AVG(credit) AS avg_credit_2025 FROM per2025 GROUP BY class_id ) SELECT a2025.class_id, ROUND(a2024.avg_credit_2024, 2) AS avg_credit_2024, ROUND(a2025.avg_credit_2025, 2) AS avg_credit_2025, ROUND((a2025.avg_credit_2025 - a2024.avg_credit_2024), 2) AS diff_avg_credit_2025_minus_2024 FROM a2025 JOIN a2024 ON a2024.class_id = a2025.class_id ORDER BY diff_avg_credit_2025_minus_2024 DESC, a2025.class_id ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 比较2024与2025学生表中家庭地区编号为2且在读的学生数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS home_region2_active_cnt FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND home_region_id=2 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS home_region2_active_cnt FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND home_region_id=2;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中课程数量，去重课程编号并排除退课，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT course_id) AS distinct_course_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT course_id) AS distinct_course_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0;

question: 比较2024与2025在同一课程编号上通过率，总评不低于60，返回通过率最高的排名第一的课程在两年各自的课程编号与通过率。
query: WITH per2024 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id ), passrate2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment_id) AS total_enroll_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN enrollment_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_enroll_cnt FROM per2024 GROUP BY course_id ), per2025 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id ), passrate2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment_id) AS total_enroll_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN enrollment_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_enroll_cnt FROM per2025 GROUP BY course_id ) (SELECT '2024' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p.pass_enroll_cnt / NULLIF(p.total_enroll_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM passrate2024 p JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT '2025' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p.pass_enroll_cnt / NULLIF(p.total_enroll_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM passrate2025 p JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1);

question: 比较2024与2025课程表课程名以“高”开头的课程数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_start_gao_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_name LIKE '高%' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_start_gao_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_name LIKE '高%';

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程学分不低于4且课程类型为必修的课程数量，返回两年数量与差值，即2025减2024。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course WHERE credit>=4 AND course_type='必修'), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course WHERE credit>=4 AND course_type='必修') SELECT (b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中教师工号最小的教师姓名，若两年不同返回两年各自的最小教师信息。
query: (SELECT '2024' AS year, teacher_no, teacher_name FROM education_2024.teacher ORDER BY teacher_no ASC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT '2025' AS year, teacher_no, teacher_name FROM education_2025.teacher ORDER BY teacher_no ASC LIMIT 1);

question: 统计2024与2025两年中学生表里家庭地区编号发生变化的学生数量，同学号对比，返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.student_id) AS home_region_changed_cnt FROM education_2024.student a JOIN education_2025.student b ON b.student_id=a.student_id WHERE COALESCE(a.home_region_id,-1)<>COALESCE(b.home_region_id,-1);

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中课程选课平均人数，排除退课，先对每门课求去重学生数再取平均，返回两年平均选课人数。
query: WITH per2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_student_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id), per2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_student_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT (SELECT ROUND(AVG(enroll_student_cnt),2) FROM per2024) AS avg_enroll_students_per_course_2024, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(enroll_student_cnt),2) FROM per2025) AS avg_enroll_students_per_course_2025;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程名包含“英语”的课程数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_name LIKE '%英语%'), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_name LIKE '%英语%') SELECT (b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每门课程的及格率，总评不低于60并排除退课，并返回及格率提升最大的排名第一的课程，即2025减2024。
query: WITH score2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN enrollment_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2024 GROUP BY course_id), score2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN enrollment_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((a2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(a2025.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2025_pct, ROUND((a2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(a2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_2024_pct, ROUND(((a2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(a2025.total_cnt,0))-(a2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(a2024.total_cnt,0)))*100,2) AS pass_rate_diff_pct FROM agg2025 a2025 JOIN agg2024 a2024 ON a2024.course_id=a2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=a2025.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_diff_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二每班级平均及格率，总评不低于60并排除退课，先班级后平均，返回两年平均班级及格率。
query: WITH per2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, e.student_id ), agg2024 AS ( SELECT class_id, (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT student_id), 0)) * 100 AS class_pass_rate_pct FROM per2024 GROUP BY class_id ), per2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, e.student_id ), agg2025 AS ( SELECT class_id, (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT student_id), 0)) * 100 AS class_pass_rate_pct FROM per2025 GROUP BY class_id ) SELECT ROUND(AVG(agg2024.class_pass_rate_pct), 2) AS avg_class_pass_rate_pct_2024, ROUND(AVG(agg2025.class_pass_rate_pct), 2) AS avg_class_pass_rate_pct_2025 FROM agg2024 CROSS JOIN agg2025;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程类型为选修的课程数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_type='选修'), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_type='选修') SELECT (b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中班级的平均总评折算分前3，排除退课，返回两年各自前3班级及平均分。
query: WITH per2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id ), a2024 AS ( SELECT class_id, ROUND(AVG(total_score), 2) AS avg_total_2024 FROM per2024 GROUP BY class_id ), per2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id ), a2025 AS ( SELECT class_id, ROUND(AVG(total_score), 2) AS avg_total_2025 FROM per2025 GROUP BY class_id ) (SELECT '2024' AS year, class_id, avg_total_2024 FROM a2024 ORDER BY avg_total_2024 DESC, class_id ASC LIMIT 3) UNION ALL (SELECT '2025' AS year, class_id, avg_total_2025 FROM a2025 ORDER BY avg_total_2025 DESC, class_id ASC LIMIT 3);

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中教师工号数量，不去重，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_rows_cnt FROM education_2024.teacher UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_rows_cnt FROM education_2025.teacher;

question: 比较2024与2025中两年共同存在的学号数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.student_id) AS common_student_cnt FROM education_2024.student a JOIN education_2025.student b ON b.student_id=a.student_id;

question: 比较2024与2025两年中共同课程编号数量，并返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.course_id) AS common_course_cnt FROM education_2024.course a JOIN education_2025.course b ON b.course_id=a.course_id;

question: 比较2024与2025两年中共同课程里学分不同的课程数量，并返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.course_id) AS common_courses_credit_diff_cnt FROM education_2024.course a JOIN education_2025.course b ON b.course_id=a.course_id WHERE a.credit<>b.credit;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中同一课程的选课人数，去重学号，排名第一的课程，返回课程编号、两年人数与差值，即2025减2024。
query: WITH p2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id), p2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COALESCE(p2024.enroll_cnt_2024,0) AS enroll_cnt_2024, COALESCE(p2025.enroll_cnt_2025,0) AS enroll_cnt_2025, COALESCE(p2025.enroll_cnt_2025,0)-COALESCE(p2024.enroll_cnt_2024,0) AS diff_enroll_cnt_2025_minus_2024 FROM p2025 LEFT JOIN p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY diff_enroll_cnt_2025_minus_2024 DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二退课记录数，不去重学生，按选课记录行，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS withdraw_enrollment_rows_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=2 AND is_withdraw=1 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS withdraw_enrollment_rows_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=2 AND is_withdraw=1;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中课程总评平均分，排除退课，下降最多的排名第一的课程，即2025减2024差值最小，返回课程编号、两年平均分与差值。
query: WITH per2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), a2024 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2024 FROM per2024 GROUP BY course_id), per2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), a2025 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2025 FROM per2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND(a2024.avg_total_2024,2) AS avg_total_2024, ROUND(a2025.avg_total_2025,2) AS avg_total_2025, ROUND(a2025.avg_total_2025-a2024.avg_total_2024,2) AS diff_avg_total_2025_minus_2024 FROM a2025 JOIN a2024 ON a2024.course_id=a2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=a2025.course_id ORDER BY diff_avg_total_2025_minus_2024 ASC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程类型为必修的课程数量差，即2025减2024，并返回两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_type='必修'), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_type='必修') SELECT b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025学生表中学籍状态为在读且性别为女性的数量差，即2025减2024，并返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND gender_code='F'), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND gender_code='F') SELECT b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 统计2024与2025两年共同存在的课程数，课程编号相同，并进一步计算这些共同课程中学分不同的课程数。
query: WITH common_courses AS (SELECT a.course_id FROM education_2024.course a JOIN education_2025.course b ON b.course_id=a.course_id) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM common_courses) AS common_course_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM common_courses cc JOIN education_2024.course a ON a.course_id=cc.course_id JOIN education_2025.course b ON b.course_id=cc.course_id WHERE COALESCE(a.credit,-1)<>COALESCE(b.credit,-1)) AS common_courses_credit_diff_cnt;

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中教师姓名以“张”开头的教师数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_name_like_zh_cnt FROM education_2024.teacher WHERE teacher_name LIKE '张%' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_name_like_zh_cnt FROM education_2025.teacher WHERE teacher_name LIKE '张%';

question: 比较2024与2025学期表中结束日期键最大的记录数量，按结束日期键排序取前1学期代码后，再统计该前1对应的行数，返回两年数量。
query: WITH t2024 AS (SELECT end_date_key, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM education_2024.semester WHERE end_date_key IS NOT NULL GROUP BY end_date_key ORDER BY end_date_key DESC LIMIT 1), t2025 AS (SELECT end_date_key, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM education_2025.semester WHERE end_date_key IS NOT NULL GROUP BY end_date_key ORDER BY end_date_key DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT t2025.cnt AS top_end_date_key_row_cnt_2025, t2024.cnt AS top_end_date_key_row_cnt_2024 FROM t2024 CROSS JOIN t2025;

question: 比较2024与2025学生表中学号长度为10的在读学生数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_student_no_len10_cnt FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND CHAR_LENGTH(student_no)=10 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_student_no_len10_cnt FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND CHAR_LENGTH(student_no)=10;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程类型为必修且学分不低于4的课程数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_type='必修' AND credit>=4), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_type='必修' AND credit>=4) SELECT (b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 统计2024与2025两年中任一学期即学期编号为1或2退课的去重学生数，并比较是否存在差异，返回两年退课学生去重人数及差值，即2025减2024。
query: WITH w2024 AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_students_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE is_withdraw=1 AND semester_id IN (1,2)), w2025 AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_students_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE is_withdraw=1 AND semester_id IN (1,2)) SELECT w2025.withdraw_students_2025-w2024.withdraw_students_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, w2024.withdraw_students_2024, w2025.withdraw_students_2025 FROM w2024 CROSS JOIN w2025;

question: 比较2024与2025中同名课程，课程名相同，返回仅存在2024、仅存在2025、两年都存在的数量。
query: WITH c2024 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT course_name FROM education_2024.course ), c2025 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT course_name FROM education_2025.course ), both_courses AS ( SELECT a.course_name FROM c2024 a JOIN c2025 b ON b.course_name = a.course_name ), only2024 AS ( SELECT a.course_name FROM c2024 a LEFT JOIN c2025 b ON b.course_name = a.course_name WHERE b.course_name IS NULL ), only2025 AS ( SELECT b.course_name FROM c2025 b LEFT JOIN c2024 a ON a.course_name = b.course_name WHERE a.course_name IS NULL ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM only2024) AS only_2024_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM only2025) AS only_2025_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM both_courses) AS both_cnt;

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中教师姓名不为空的数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_name_not_empty_cnt FROM education_2024.teacher WHERE teacher_name IS NOT NULL AND teacher_name<>'' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_name_not_empty_cnt FROM education_2025.teacher WHERE teacher_name IS NOT NULL AND teacher_name<>'';

question: 比较2024与2025学期表中起始日期键为20240101的学期数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS semester_start_is_20240101_cnt FROM education_2024.semester WHERE start_date_key=20240101 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS semester_start_is_20240101_cnt FROM education_2025.semester WHERE start_date_key=20240101;

question: 找出2024与2025两年共同存在的学生中，按学号，性别不同的学生数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS gender_changed_cnt FROM education_2024.student a JOIN education_2025.student b ON b.student_id=a.student_id WHERE COALESCE(a.gender_code,'')<>COALESCE(b.gender_code,'');

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每个班级的选课去重学生数前3，按2025人数降序，返回两年各自前3对应班级的班级编号与人数。
query: WITH p2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_student_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id ), p2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_student_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id ), top3 AS ( SELECT class_id FROM p2025 ORDER BY enroll_student_cnt_2025 DESC, class_id ASC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT t.class_id, p2024.enroll_student_cnt_2024, p2025.enroll_student_cnt_2025 FROM top3 t LEFT JOIN p2024 ON p2024.class_id = t.class_id JOIN p2025 ON p2025.class_id = t.class_id ORDER BY p2025.enroll_student_cnt_2025 DESC, t.class_id ASC;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中学分的中位数，返回两年中位数。
query: WITH ranked2024 AS (SELECT credit, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY credit) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt FROM education_2024.course), ranked2025 AS (SELECT credit, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY credit) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt FROM education_2025.course) SELECT (SELECT AVG(credit) FROM ranked2024 WHERE rn IN (FLOOR((cnt+1)/2), CEIL((cnt+1)/2))) AS median_credit_2024, (SELECT AVG(credit) FROM ranked2025 WHERE rn IN (FLOOR((cnt+1)/2), CEIL((cnt+1)/2))) AS median_credit_2025;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程的退课学生去重数差，即2025减2024，前5，返回课程编号、课程名与差值。
query: WITH w2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_student_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1 GROUP BY course_id), w2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_student_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COALESCE(w2025.withdraw_student_cnt_2025,0)-COALESCE(w2024.withdraw_student_cnt_2024,0) AS withdraw_student_diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM w2025 LEFT JOIN w2024 ON w2024.course_id=w2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=w2025.course_id ORDER BY withdraw_student_diff_2025_minus_2024 DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 5;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程名以“数”结尾的数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_end_with_数_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_name LIKE '%数' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_end_with_数_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_name LIKE '%数';

question: 比较2024与2025学生表家庭地区编号为3的在读学生人数，返回两年人数。
query: (SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS student_cnt FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND home_region_id = 3) UNION ALL (SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS student_cnt FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND home_region_id = 3);

question: 比较2024与2025学期表中结束日期键为空或0的学期数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS semester_end_date_empty_or_zero_cnt FROM education_2024.semester WHERE end_date_key IS NULL OR end_date_key=0 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS semester_end_date_empty_or_zero_cnt FROM education_2025.semester WHERE end_date_key IS NULL OR end_date_key=0;

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中院系编号为1的教师人数，返回两年人数及差值，即2025减2024。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS teacher_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.teacher WHERE department_id=1), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS teacher_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.teacher WHERE department_id=1) SELECT b.teacher_cnt_2025-a.teacher_cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.teacher_cnt_2024, b.teacher_cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 找出2024与2025两年共同存在的课程编号，且课程学分在两年不同的课程数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.course_id) AS courses_credit_changed_cnt FROM education_2024.course a JOIN education_2025.course b ON b.course_id=a.course_id WHERE COALESCE(a.credit,-1)<>COALESCE(b.credit,-1);

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每门课程参与人数，去重学号，返回两年平均参与人数，每门课平均后再取均值。
query: WITH per2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id), per2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT (SELECT ROUND(AVG(enroll_cnt),2) FROM per2024) AS avg_enroll_per_course_2024, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(enroll_cnt),2) FROM per2025) AS avg_enroll_per_course_2025;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每个班级的平均总评折算分，排除退课，返回2025与2024差值最大的排名第一的班级，即2025减2024。
query: WITH s2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id ), a2024 AS ( SELECT class_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2024 FROM s2024 GROUP BY class_id ), s2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id ), a2025 AS ( SELECT class_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2025 FROM s2025 GROUP BY class_id ) SELECT a2025.class_id, ROUND(a2024.avg_total_2024, 2) AS avg_total_2024, ROUND(a2025.avg_total_2025, 2) AS avg_total_2025, ROUND(a2025.avg_total_2025 - a2024.avg_total_2024, 2) AS diff_avg_total_2025_minus_2024 FROM a2025 JOIN a2024 ON a2024.class_id = a2025.class_id ORDER BY diff_avg_total_2025_minus_2024 DESC, a2025.class_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中电话为空或空字符串的教师记录数，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_phone_empty_rows_cnt FROM education_2024.teacher WHERE phone IS NULL OR phone='' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_phone_empty_rows_cnt FROM education_2025.teacher WHERE phone IS NULL OR phone='';

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中总评不低于60的学生去重人数，返回两年人数及差值，即2025减2024。
