query: WITH pass2024 AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS pass_students_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.student_id), x2024 AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS pass_students_2024 FROM (SELECT e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.student_id) t WHERE t.total_score>=60), x2025 AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS pass_students_2025 FROM (SELECT e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.student_id) t WHERE t.total_score>=60) SELECT (x2025.pass_students_2025-x2024.pass_students_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, x2024.pass_students_2024, x2025.pass_students_2025 FROM x2024 CROSS JOIN x2025;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程数量差，即2025减2024，同时返回两年的课程总数。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS course_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS course_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course) SELECT b.course_cnt_2025-a.course_cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.course_cnt_2024, b.course_cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025学期表中学期代码包含2025的数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS semester_code_like_2025_cnt FROM education_2024.semester WHERE semester_code LIKE '%2025%' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS semester_code_like_2025_cnt FROM education_2025.semester WHERE semester_code LIKE '%2025%';

question: 找出2024与2025两年共同存在的课程编号中，退课人数，退课标记为1并去重学号，在两年同样为0的课程数量。
query: WITH w2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE is_withdraw=1 GROUP BY course_id), w2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE is_withdraw=1 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS common_courses_withdraw_zero_in_both_cnt FROM education_2024.course a JOIN education_2025.course b ON b.course_id=a.course_id LEFT JOIN w2024 x ON x.course_id=a.course_id LEFT JOIN w2025 y ON y.course_id=a.course_id WHERE COALESCE(x.withdraw_cnt_2024,0)=0 AND COALESCE(y.withdraw_cnt_2025,0)=0;

question: 比较2024与2025两年中共同教师工号数量，并返回数量，教师工号去重。
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.teacher_no) AS common_teacher_no_cnt FROM education_2024.teacher a JOIN education_2025.teacher b ON b.teacher_no=a.teacher_no;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每门课程的平均总评折算分，排除退课，返回差值绝对值最大的前3门课程。
query: WITH per2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), a2024 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2024 FROM per2024 GROUP BY course_id), per2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), a2025 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2025 FROM per2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND(a2024.avg_total_2024,2) AS avg_total_2024, ROUND(a2025.avg_total_2025,2) AS avg_total_2025, ROUND(ABS(a2025.avg_total_2025-a2024.avg_total_2024),2) AS abs_diff FROM a2025 JOIN a2024 ON a2024.course_id=a2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=a2025.course_id ORDER BY abs_diff DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 3;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程类型为“选修”的数量差，即2025减2024，并返回两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS elective_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_type='选修'), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS elective_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_type='选修') SELECT b.elective_cnt_2025-a.elective_cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.elective_cnt_2024, b.elective_cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025学生表中家庭地区编号为2且性别为女性的在读学生数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND home_region_id=2 AND gender_code='F'), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND home_region_id=2 AND gender_code='F') SELECT (b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025两年共同学生中，按学号，学期一中平均总评折算分提升最多的第一名，即2025减2024，排除退课。
query: WITH per2024 AS ( SELECT e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.student_id, e.enrollment_id ), avg2024 AS ( SELECT student_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2024 FROM per2024 GROUP BY student_id ), per2025 AS ( SELECT e.student_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.student_id, e.enrollment_id ), avg2025 AS ( SELECT student_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2025 FROM per2025 GROUP BY student_id ) SELECT s.student_no, ROUND(a.avg_total_2024, 2) AS avg_total_2024, ROUND(b.avg_total_2025, 2) AS avg_total_2025, ROUND(b.avg_total_2025 - a.avg_total_2024, 2) AS diff_avg_total_2025_minus_2024 FROM avg2024 a JOIN avg2025 b ON b.student_id = a.student_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = b.student_id ORDER BY diff_avg_total_2025_minus_2024 DESC, s.student_no ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程名包含“实验”的课程数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_like_实验_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_name LIKE '%实验%' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_like_实验_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_name LIKE '%实验%';

question: 比较2024与2025学期一课程选择中，教师编号出现的课程数，教师编号按课程表字段假设存在，返回两年课程数及差值。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.course_id) AS taught_course_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND c.teacher_id IS NOT NULL), b AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.course_id) AS taught_course_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND c.teacher_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT (b.taught_course_cnt_2025-a.taught_course_cnt_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.taught_course_cnt_2024, b.taught_course_cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程的通过率，总评不低于60并排除退课，并返回通过率最低的排名第一的课程，两年分别取最低。
query: WITH student_score2024 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id ), pass2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt FROM student_score2024 GROUP BY course_id ), student_score2025 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id ), pass2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN student_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt FROM student_score2025 GROUP BY course_id ) (SELECT '2024' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p.pass_cnt / NULLIF(p.total_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM pass2024 p JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct ASC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT '2025' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p.pass_cnt / NULLIF(p.total_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM pass2025 p JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct ASC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1);

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中课程选择中每门课程平均退课人数，去重学号，返回两年差值，即2025减2024，前5。
query: WITH w2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_students_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1 GROUP BY course_id), w2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_students_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COALESCE(w2025.withdraw_students_cnt,0)-COALESCE(w2024.withdraw_students_cnt,0) AS withdraw_student_diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM w2025 LEFT JOIN w2024 ON w2024.course_id=w2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=w2025.course_id ORDER BY withdraw_student_diff_2025_minus_2024 DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 5;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中学分为5的课程数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_credit_5_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE credit=5 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_credit_5_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE credit=5;

question: 比较2024与2025两年共同存在的班级编号，在学期一中选课人数，去重学号，差值前3，即2025减2024。
query: WITH a2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_student_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id ), a2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_student_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id ) SELECT a2025.class_id, COALESCE(a2024.enroll_student_cnt_2024, 0) AS enroll_student_cnt_2024, COALESCE(a2025.enroll_student_cnt_2025, 0) AS enroll_student_cnt_2025, COALESCE(a2025.enroll_student_cnt_2025, 0) - COALESCE(a2024.enroll_student_cnt_2024, 0) AS diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM a2025 JOIN a2024 ON a2024.class_id = a2025.class_id ORDER BY diff_2025_minus_2024 DESC, a2025.class_id ASC LIMIT 3;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中每个院系编号的课程数量差，即2025减2024，输出差值不为0的院系数量。
query: WITH c2024 AS ( SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS course_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course GROUP BY department_id ), c2025 AS ( SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS course_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course GROUP BY department_id ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS dept_course_cnt_diff_nonzero_cnt FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(c2024.department_id, c2025.department_id) AS department_id, COALESCE(c2025.course_cnt_2025, 0) - COALESCE(c2024.course_cnt_2024, 0) AS diff FROM c2024 LEFT JOIN c2025 ON c2025.department_id = c2024.department_id UNION SELECT COALESCE(c2024.department_id, c2025.department_id) AS department_id, COALESCE(c2025.course_cnt_2025, 0) - COALESCE(c2024.course_cnt_2024, 0) AS diff FROM c2024 RIGHT JOIN c2025 ON c2025.department_id = c2024.department_id WHERE c2024.department_id IS NULL ) t WHERE diff <> 0;

question: 比较2024与2025学生表中性别为男性的数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS male_cnt FROM education_2024.student WHERE gender_code='M' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS male_cnt FROM education_2025.student WHERE gender_code='M';

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程的平均退课人数，去重学号，返回两年各自平均值，对课程求均值。
query: WITH w2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1 GROUP BY course_id), w2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT (SELECT ROUND(AVG(withdraw_cnt),2) FROM w2024) AS avg_withdraw_cnt_per_course_2024, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(withdraw_cnt),2) FROM w2025) AS avg_withdraw_cnt_per_course_2025;

question: 比较2024与2025两年中共同存在的学生中，家庭地区编号在两年都为空或缺失的数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS home_region_both_null_cnt FROM education_2024.student a JOIN education_2025.student b ON b.student_id=a.student_id WHERE (a.home_region_id IS NULL OR a.home_region_id=0) AND (b.home_region_id IS NULL OR b.home_region_id=0);

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中课程选择记录中不同教师编号的数量，假设通过课程表教师编号，返回两年数量与差值。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.teacher_id) AS distinct_teacher_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND c.teacher_id IS NOT NULL), b AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.teacher_id) AS distinct_teacher_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND c.teacher_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT (b.distinct_teacher_cnt_2025-a.distinct_teacher_cnt_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.distinct_teacher_cnt_2024, b.distinct_teacher_cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程名不为空的数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_not_empty_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_name IS NOT NULL AND course_name<>'' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_not_empty_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_name IS NOT NULL AND course_name<>'';

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中退课率最低的排名第一的课程，退课率等于退课去重人数除以选课去重人数，返回两年各自退课率最低课程。
query: WITH base2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, student_id, MAX(is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 GROUP BY course_id, student_id ), agg2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdraw_student_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_student_cnt FROM base2024 GROUP BY course_id ), base2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, student_id, MAX(is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 GROUP BY course_id, student_id ), agg2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdraw_student_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_student_cnt FROM base2025 GROUP BY course_id ) (SELECT '2024' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((a.withdraw_student_cnt / NULLIF(a.total_student_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM agg2024 a JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = a.course_id ORDER BY withdraw_rate_pct ASC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT '2025' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((a.withdraw_student_cnt / NULLIF(a.total_student_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM agg2025 a JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = a.course_id ORDER BY withdraw_rate_pct ASC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1);

question: 比较2024与2025两年共同存在的课程编号中，课程名称发生变化的课程数量，即课程名不同。
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.course_id) AS course_name_changed_cnt FROM education_2024.course a JOIN education_2025.course b ON b.course_id=a.course_id WHERE COALESCE(a.course_name,'')<>COALESCE(b.course_name,'');

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每个学生按学号的选课门数第一名，选课去重，并返回两年各自该学生的学号与选课门数。
query: WITH p2024 AS ( SELECT student_id, COUNT(DISTINCT course_id) AS course_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 AND is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY student_id ), p2025 AS ( SELECT student_id, COUNT(DISTINCT course_id) AS course_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 AND is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY student_id ) (SELECT '2024' AS year, s.student_no, p.course_cnt_2024 FROM p2024 p JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = p.student_id ORDER BY p.course_cnt_2024 DESC, s.student_no ASC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT '2025' AS year, s.student_no, p.course_cnt_2025 FROM p2025 p JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = p.student_id ORDER BY p.course_cnt_2025 DESC, s.student_no ASC LIMIT 1);

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中教师工号去重后的数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT teacher_no) AS distinct_teacher_no_cnt FROM education_2024.teacher UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT teacher_no) AS distinct_teacher_no_cnt FROM education_2025.teacher;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程的选课总人数，去重学生，返回两年排名前5课程，按2025人数降序，并输出两年人数。
query: WITH p2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_student_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id), p2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_student_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COALESCE(p2024.enroll_student_cnt_2024,0) AS enroll_student_cnt_2024, COALESCE(p2025.enroll_student_cnt_2025,0) AS enroll_student_cnt_2025 FROM (SELECT course_id FROM p2025 ORDER BY enroll_student_cnt_2025 DESC, course_id ASC LIMIT 5) t JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=t.course_id LEFT JOIN p2024 ON p2024.course_id=t.course_id JOIN p2025 ON p2025.course_id=t.course_id ORDER BY p2025.enroll_student_cnt_2025 DESC, c.course_id ASC;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中院系编号为2的课程平均学分，返回两年平均值，保留两位小数，及差值，即2025减2024。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT ROUND(AVG(credit),2) AS avg_credit_2024 FROM education_2024.course WHERE department_id=2), b AS (SELECT ROUND(AVG(credit),2) AS avg_credit_2025 FROM education_2025.course WHERE department_id=2) SELECT (b.avg_credit_2025-a.avg_credit_2024) AS diff_avg_credit_2025_minus_2024, a.avg_credit_2024, b.avg_credit_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中学分为3的课程数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_credit_3_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE credit=3 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_credit_3_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE credit=3;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中课程退课率最高的排名第一课程，退课率等于退课去重学生数除以选课去重学生数，返回两年各自的课程编号与退课率。
query: WITH base2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, student_id, MAX(is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 GROUP BY course_id, student_id ), agg2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdraw_student_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_student_cnt FROM base2024 GROUP BY course_id ), base2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, student_id, MAX(is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 GROUP BY course_id, student_id ), agg2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdraw_student_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_student_cnt FROM base2025 GROUP BY course_id ) (SELECT '2024' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((a.withdraw_student_cnt / NULLIF(a.total_student_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM agg2024 a JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = a.course_id ORDER BY withdraw_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT '2025' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((a.withdraw_student_cnt / NULLIF(a.total_student_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM agg2025 a JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = a.course_id ORDER BY withdraw_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1);

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中电话不为空且不为空字符串的教师比例，非空除以总数，返回两年百分比。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN phone IS NOT NULL AND phone<>'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)*100,2) AS phone_non_empty_rate_pct FROM education_2024.teacher UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN phone IS NOT NULL AND phone<>'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)*100,2) AS phone_non_empty_rate_pct FROM education_2025.teacher;

question: 比较2024与2025学生表家庭地区编号为1且学籍状态为在读的学生数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND home_region_id=1), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND home_region_id=1) SELECT b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二每门课程的平均总评折算分，排除退课并按每门课求平均分，返回两年平均总分的差值，即2025减2024。
query: WITH per_enroll2024 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id ), m2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_course_score_2024 FROM per_enroll2024 GROUP BY course_id ), per_enroll2025 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id ), m2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_course_score_2025 FROM per_enroll2025 GROUP BY course_id ) SELECT (SELECT ROUND(AVG(avg_course_score_2025), 2) FROM m2025) - (SELECT ROUND(AVG(avg_course_score_2024), 2) FROM m2024) AS diff_avg_course_score_2025_minus_2024;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程类型为选修的数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS elective_course_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_type='选修' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS elective_course_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_type='选修';

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每个班级的选课去重学生数差值前3，即2025减2024，返回班级编号与两年人数、差值。
query: WITH p2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id ), p2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id ) SELECT p2025.class_id, COALESCE(p2024.enroll_cnt_2024, 0) AS enroll_cnt_2024, p2025.enroll_cnt_2025, p2025.enroll_cnt_2025 - COALESCE(p2024.enroll_cnt_2024, 0) AS diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM p2025 LEFT JOIN p2024 ON p2024.class_id = p2025.class_id ORDER BY diff_2025_minus_2024 DESC, p2025.class_id ASC LIMIT 3;

question: 比较2024与2025学期表中学期代码去重后，公共的学期代码数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS common_semester_code_cnt FROM (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester WHERE semester_code IS NOT NULL AND semester_code<>'' ) a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester WHERE semester_code IS NOT NULL AND semester_code<>'' ) b ON b.semester_code=a.semester_code;

question: 比较2024与2025两年中共同存在的课程编号数量，并计算其中课程名不同的数量。
query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.course_id) FROM education_2024.course a JOIN education_2025.course b ON b.course_id=a.course_id) AS common_course_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.course_id) FROM education_2024.course a JOIN education_2025.course b ON b.course_id=a.course_id WHERE COALESCE(a.course_name,'')<>COALESCE(b.course_name,'')) AS common_course_name_diff_cnt;

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中教师工号去重数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT teacher_no) AS distinct_teacher_no_cnt FROM education_2024.teacher UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT teacher_no) AS distinct_teacher_no_cnt FROM education_2025.teacher;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程的通过率，总评不低于60，排除退课，且按去重学号计，并返回两年差值最大的排名第一的课程，即2025减2024。
query: WITH pass2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN e.student_id END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id JOIN (SELECT enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN exam_item='平时' THEN score*0.30 WHEN exam_item='期中' THEN score*0.30 WHEN exam_item='期末' THEN score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score GROUP BY enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id), pass2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.total_score>=60 THEN e.student_id END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id JOIN (SELECT enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN exam_item='平时' THEN score*0.30 WHEN exam_item='期中' THEN score*0.30 WHEN exam_item='期末' THEN score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.exam_score GROUP BY enrollment_id) t ON t.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2025.total_cnt,0)-p2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(p2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS diff_pass_rate_pct FROM pass2025 p2025 JOIN pass2024 p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY diff_pass_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中学分为0的课程数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS credit_zero_course_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE credit=0 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS credit_zero_course_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE credit=0;

question: 比较2024与2025学生表中家庭地区编号为2的学生在读数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND home_region_id=2), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND home_region_id=2) SELECT b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025学期表中学期代码为空或空字符串的行数，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS semester_code_empty_rows_cnt FROM education_2024.semester WHERE semester_code IS NULL OR semester_code='' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS semester_code_empty_rows_cnt FROM education_2025.semester WHERE semester_code IS NULL OR semester_code='';

question: 比较2024与2025学生表中学籍状态为在读的学生总数差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE'), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE') SELECT b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中院系编号的数量分布，返回院系编号及两年教师数，仅返回两年都存在的院系编号。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS teacher_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.teacher GROUP BY department_id), b AS (SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS teacher_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.teacher GROUP BY department_id) SELECT a.department_id, a.teacher_cnt_2024, b.teacher_cnt_2025 FROM a JOIN b ON b.department_id=a.department_id ORDER BY b.teacher_cnt_2025 DESC, a.department_id ASC;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程名以“英语”开头的课程数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_start_英语_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_name LIKE '英语%' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_start_英语_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_name LIKE '英语%';

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中退课记录数，不去重，按选课记录行，差值前3课程，即2025减2024，返回课程编号、两年退课行数、差值。
query: WITH w2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS withdraw_rows_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1 GROUP BY course_id), w2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS withdraw_rows_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, COALESCE(w2024.withdraw_rows_2024,0) AS withdraw_rows_2024, COALESCE(w2025.withdraw_rows_2025,0) AS withdraw_rows_2025, COALESCE(w2025.withdraw_rows_2025,0)-COALESCE(w2024.withdraw_rows_2024,0) AS diff_withdraw_rows_2025_minus_2024 FROM w2025 LEFT JOIN w2024 ON w2024.course_id=w2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=w2025.course_id ORDER BY diff_withdraw_rows_2025_minus_2024 DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 3;

question: 比较2024与2025两年中共同存在的学生数量，按学号，以及这些共同学生中性别不同数量。
query: WITH common AS (SELECT a.student_id, a.gender_code AS gender_2024, b.gender_code AS gender_2025 FROM education_2024.student a JOIN education_2025.student b ON b.student_id=a.student_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS common_student_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(gender_2024,'')<>COALESCE(gender_2025,'') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gender_diff_in_common_cnt FROM common;

question: 比较2024与2025教师表教师姓名包含“王”的数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_name_like_wang_cnt FROM education_2024.teacher WHERE teacher_name LIKE '%王%' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_name_like_wang_cnt FROM education_2025.teacher WHERE teacher_name LIKE '%王%';

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中学分不低于6且课程类型为必修的课程数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值及两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course WHERE credit>=6 AND course_type='必修'), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course WHERE credit>=6 AND course_type='必修') SELECT (b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程的平均参与人数，去重学号后再对课程求平均，返回两年平均值。
query: WITH p2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id), p2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT (SELECT ROUND(AVG(enroll_cnt),2) FROM p2024) AS avg_enroll_students_per_course_2024, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(enroll_cnt),2) FROM p2025) AS avg_enroll_students_per_course_2025;

question: 比较2024与2025学生表中性别为男性的在读学生数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS male_active_cnt FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND gender_code='M' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS male_active_cnt FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND gender_code='M';

question: 比较2024与2025教师表电话为空或空字符串的教师数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.teacher WHERE phone IS NULL OR phone=''), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.teacher WHERE phone IS NULL OR phone='') SELECT b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一退课去重学生数前3课程，即2025减2024，返回课程编号、两年退课人数、差值。
query: WITH w2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_students_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1 GROUP BY course_id), w2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_students_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, COALESCE(w2024.withdraw_students_2024,0) AS withdraw_students_2024, COALESCE(w2025.withdraw_students_2025,0) AS withdraw_students_2025, COALESCE(w2025.withdraw_students_2025,0)-COALESCE(w2024.withdraw_students_2024,0) AS diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM w2025 LEFT JOIN w2024 ON w2024.course_id=w2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=w2025.course_id ORDER BY diff_2025_minus_2024 DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 3;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表课程名不为空的数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_not_empty_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_name IS NOT NULL AND course_name<>'' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_not_empty_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_name IS NOT NULL AND course_name<>'';

question: 比较2024与2025两年共同存在的班级数，按班级编号，返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.class_id) AS common_class_cnt FROM (SELECT DISTINCT s.class_id FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id) a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT s.class_id FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id) b ON b.class_id = a.class_id;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每个班级平均退课率，退课去重学生除以该班选课去重学生，最后对班级求平均，返回两年平均退课率。
query: WITH base2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.course_id, e.student_id, MAX(e.is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.course_id, e.student_id ), byclass2024 AS ( SELECT class_id, (SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM base2024 GROUP BY class_id ), base2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.course_id, e.student_id, MAX(e.is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.course_id, e.student_id ), byclass2025 AS ( SELECT class_id, (SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM base2025 GROUP BY class_id ) SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(withdraw_rate_pct) FROM byclass2024), 2) AS avg_class_withdraw_rate_pct_2024, ROUND((SELECT AVG(withdraw_rate_pct) FROM byclass2025), 2) AS avg_class_withdraw_rate_pct_2025;

question: 比较2024与2025学期表起始日期键为0或空的记录数，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS start_date_key_empty_or_zero_cnt FROM education_2024.semester WHERE start_date_key IS NULL OR start_date_key=0 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS start_date_key_empty_or_zero_cnt FROM education_2025.semester WHERE start_date_key IS NULL OR start_date_key=0;

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中院系编号为1的电话不为空数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_dept1_phone_non_empty_cnt FROM education_2024.teacher WHERE department_id=1 AND phone IS NOT NULL AND phone<>'' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_dept1_phone_non_empty_cnt FROM education_2025.teacher WHERE department_id=1 AND phone IS NOT NULL AND phone<>'';

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中院系编号各自数量差，即2025减2024，只输出差值不为0的院系编号及差值。
query: WITH c2024 AS (SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course GROUP BY department_id), c2025 AS (SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course GROUP BY department_id) SELECT COALESCE(c2025.department_id,c2024.department_id) AS department_id, COALESCE(c2025.cnt_2025,0)-COALESCE(c2024.cnt_2024,0) AS diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM c2025 LEFT JOIN c2024 ON c2024.department_id=c2025.department_id UNION SELECT COALESCE(c2025.department_id,c2024.department_id) AS department_id, COALESCE(c2025.cnt_2025,0)-COALESCE(c2024.cnt_2024,0) AS diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM c2024 LEFT JOIN c2025 ON c2025.department_id=c2024.department_id WHERE c2025.department_id IS NULL ORDER BY department_id ASC;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每门课程的平均学分，取课程表学分，返回两年平均学分，对课程求平均。
query: WITH p2024 AS (SELECT DISTINCT e.course_id, c.credit FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0), p2025 AS (SELECT DISTINCT e.course_id, c.credit FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0) SELECT (SELECT ROUND(AVG(credit),2) FROM p2024) AS avg_credit_for_distinct_courses_2024, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(credit),2) FROM p2025) AS avg_credit_for_distinct_courses_2025;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表课程类型为必修且课程名包含“实验”的数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS compulsory_course_name_like_实验_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_type='必修' AND course_name LIKE '%实验%' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS compulsory_course_name_like_实验_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_type='必修' AND course_name LIKE '%实验%';

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中通过率不低于60的课程数量，按去重学生计算，返回两年数量。
query: WITH pass2024 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN e.student_id END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN ( SELECT enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN exam_item = '平时' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期中' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期末' THEN score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score GROUP BY enrollment_id ) t ON t.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id ), pass2025 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN e.student_id END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN ( SELECT enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN exam_item = '平时' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期中' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期末' THEN score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.exam_score GROUP BY enrollment_id ) t ON t.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id ) SELECT '2024' AS year, SUM(CASE WHEN (pass_cnt / NULLIF(total_cnt, 0)) >= 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS course_pass_rate_ge60_cnt FROM pass2024 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, SUM(CASE WHEN (pass_cnt / NULLIF(total_cnt, 0)) >= 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS course_pass_rate_ge60_cnt FROM pass2025;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中学分在1、2、3范围内的课程数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS credit_in_1_2_3_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE credit IN (1,2,3) UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS credit_in_1_2_3_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE credit IN (1,2,3);

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中每个院系编号的课程数量前3，按2025数量降序，返回前3院系编号及两年数量。
query: WITH c2024 AS (SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS course_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course GROUP BY department_id), c2025 AS (SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS course_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course GROUP BY department_id) SELECT t.department_id, COALESCE(c2024.course_cnt_2024,0) AS course_cnt_2024, t.course_cnt_2025 FROM (SELECT * FROM c2025 ORDER BY course_cnt_2025 DESC, department_id ASC LIMIT 3) t LEFT JOIN c2024 ON c2024.department_id=t.department_id ORDER BY t.course_cnt_2025 DESC, t.department_id ASC;

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中院系编号为2的教师数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.teacher WHERE department_id=2), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.teacher WHERE department_id=2) SELECT b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025学生表中学籍状态为在读且性别为男性或女性的数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_gender_M_or_F_cnt FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND gender_code IN ('M','F') UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS active_gender_M_or_F_cnt FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND gender_code IN ('M','F');

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每门课程的选课人数第一名，按2025人数降序，返回课程编号与两年人数。
query: WITH p2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id), p2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, COALESCE(p2024.enroll_cnt_2024,0) AS enroll_cnt_2024, p2025.enroll_cnt_2025 FROM p2025 LEFT JOIN p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY p2025.enroll_cnt_2025 DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程类型为必修的学分平均差，即2025减2024，返回均值与差值。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT AVG(credit) AS avg_credit_2024 FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_type='必修'), b AS (SELECT AVG(credit) AS avg_credit_2025 FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_type='必修') SELECT ROUND(b.avg_credit_2025-a.avg_credit_2024,2) AS diff_avg_credit_2025_minus_2024, ROUND(a.avg_credit_2024,2) AS avg_credit_2024, ROUND(b.avg_credit_2025,2) AS avg_credit_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程名包含“语文”的课程数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_like_语文_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_name LIKE '%语文%' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_like_语文_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_name LIKE '%语文%';

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每个班级的平均总评折算分差，即2025减2024，返回差值绝对值最大的排名第一的班级。
query: WITH s2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id ), a2024 AS ( SELECT class_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2024 FROM s2024 GROUP BY class_id ), s2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.enrollment_id ), a2025 AS ( SELECT class_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2025 FROM s2025 GROUP BY class_id ) SELECT a2025.class_id, ROUND(a2024.avg_total_2024, 2) AS avg_total_2024, ROUND(a2025.avg_total_2025, 2) AS avg_total_2025, ROUND(ABS(a2025.avg_total_2025 - a2024.avg_total_2024), 2) AS abs_diff FROM a2025 JOIN a2024 ON a2024.class_id = a2025.class_id ORDER BY abs_diff DESC, a2025.class_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中学分大于5的课程数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_credit_gt_5_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE credit>5 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_credit_gt_5_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE credit>5;

question: 比较2024与2025学生表中学籍状态为在读且家庭地区编号为3的数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND home_region_id=3), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND home_region_id=3) SELECT b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中教师姓名以“李”开头的数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_name_like_li_cnt FROM education_2024.teacher WHERE teacher_name LIKE '李%' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_name_like_li_cnt FROM education_2025.teacher WHERE teacher_name LIKE '李%';

question: 比较2024与2025学期表中学期代码去重后的公共数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS common_semester_code_cnt FROM (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester WHERE semester_code IS NOT NULL AND semester_code<>'' ) a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester WHERE semester_code IS NOT NULL AND semester_code<>'' ) b ON b.semester_code=a.semester_code;

question: 比较2024与2025两年共同存在的课程编号数量，以及这些共同课程中学分不同的数量。
query: WITH common_courses AS (SELECT a.course_id, a.credit AS credit_2024, b.credit AS credit_2025 FROM education_2024.course a JOIN education_2025.course b ON b.course_id=a.course_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS common_course_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(credit_2024,-1)<>COALESCE(credit_2025,-1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS common_course_credit_diff_cnt FROM common_courses;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程类型为选修的平均学分，返回两年平均值。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, ROUND(AVG(credit),2) AS avg_credit FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_type='选修' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, ROUND(AVG(credit),2) AS avg_credit FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_type='选修';

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程的平均分，按总评成绩计算，排除退课，再统计两年平均分差，即2025减2024。
query: WITH avg2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, AVG( (CASE WHEN s.exam_item='平时' THEN s.score*0.30 WHEN s.exam_item='期中' THEN s.score*0.30 WHEN s.exam_item='期末' THEN s.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) ) AS avg_course_score_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score s ON s.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id), avg2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, AVG( (CASE WHEN s.exam_item='平时' THEN s.score*0.30 WHEN s.exam_item='期中' THEN s.score*0.30 WHEN s.exam_item='期末' THEN s.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) ) AS avg_course_score_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score s ON s.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id) SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(avg_course_score_2025) FROM avg2025) - (SELECT AVG(avg_course_score_2024) FROM avg2024),2) AS diff_avg_course_score_2025_minus_2024;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中学分为4的课程数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_credit_4_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE credit=4 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_credit_4_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE credit=4;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每个班级的选课去重学生数差值前2，即2025减2024，返回班级编号与两年人数、差值。
query: WITH p2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id ), p2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id ) SELECT p2025.class_id, COALESCE(p2024.enroll_cnt_2024, 0) AS enroll_cnt_2024, p2025.enroll_cnt_2025, p2025.enroll_cnt_2025 - COALESCE(p2024.enroll_cnt_2024, 0) AS diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM p2025 LEFT JOIN p2024 ON p2024.class_id = p2025.class_id ORDER BY diff_2025_minus_2024 DESC, p2025.class_id ASC LIMIT 2;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表课程名包含“数学”的课程数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_like_数学_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_name LIKE '%数学%' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_like_数学_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_name LIKE '%数学%';

question: 比较2024与2025退课记录数，学期编号为1且退课标记为1，按课程编号统计后取差值最大的排名第一的课程，即2025减2024，返回课程编号与两年退课行数、差值。
query: WITH w2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS withdraw_rows_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 AND is_withdraw = 1 GROUP BY course_id ), w2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS withdraw_rows_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 AND is_withdraw = 1 GROUP BY course_id ) SELECT c2025.course_id, COALESCE(w2024.withdraw_rows_2024, 0) AS withdraw_rows_2024, COALESCE(c2025.withdraw_rows_2025, 0) AS withdraw_rows_2025, COALESCE(c2025.withdraw_rows_2025, 0) - COALESCE(w2024.withdraw_rows_2024, 0) AS diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM w2025 c2025 LEFT JOIN w2024 ON w2024.course_id = c2025.course_id ORDER BY diff_2025_minus_2024 DESC, c2025.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中学分为1的课程数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_credit_1_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE credit=1 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_credit_1_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE credit=1;

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中院系编号为1的教师数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.teacher WHERE department_id=1), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.teacher WHERE department_id=1) SELECT b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025两年共同存在的学生，学号相同，性别不同的学生数量。
query: WITH common_students AS (SELECT a.student_id, a.gender_code AS gender_2024, b.gender_code AS gender_2025 FROM education_2024.student a JOIN education_2025.student b ON b.student_id=a.student_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS common_student_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(gender_2024,'')<>COALESCE(gender_2025,'') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gender_diff_in_common_cnt FROM common_students;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程类型为必修的数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_type='必修'), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_type='必修') SELECT b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中通过率不低于60%的课程数量，去重学号计算，返回两年数量。
query: WITH pass2024 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN e.student_id END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN ( SELECT enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN exam_item = '平时' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期中' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期末' THEN score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score GROUP BY enrollment_id ) t ON t.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id ), pass2025 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN e.student_id END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN ( SELECT enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN exam_item = '平时' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期中' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期末' THEN score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.exam_score GROUP BY enrollment_id ) t ON t.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id ) SELECT '2024' AS year, SUM(CASE WHEN pass_cnt / NULLIF(total_cnt, 0) >= 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS course_pass_rate_ge60_cnt FROM pass2024 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, SUM(CASE WHEN pass_cnt / NULLIF(total_cnt, 0) >= 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS course_pass_rate_ge60_cnt FROM pass2025;

question: 比较2024与2025学生表中家庭地区编号为1的在读学生数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND home_region_id=1), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND home_region_id=1) SELECT b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中学分在0到3之间含3的课程数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS credit_in_0_3_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE credit>0 AND credit<=3 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS credit_in_0_3_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE credit>0 AND credit<=3;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中每个院系编号的课程数量差，即2025减2024，只返回差值不为0的院系编号及差值。
query: WITH c2024 AS ( SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course GROUP BY department_id ), c2025 AS ( SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course GROUP BY department_id ) SELECT COALESCE(c2025.department_id, c2024.department_id) AS department_id, COALESCE(c2025.cnt_2025, 0) - COALESCE(c2024.cnt_2024, 0) AS diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM c2024 LEFT JOIN c2025 ON c2024.department_id = c2025.department_id UNION SELECT COALESCE(c2025.department_id, c2024.department_id) AS department_id, COALESCE(c2025.cnt_2025, 0) - COALESCE(c2024.cnt_2024, 0) AS diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM c2024 RIGHT JOIN c2025 ON c2024.department_id = c2025.department_id WHERE c2024.department_id IS NULL;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每门课程的退课率，退课去重学生除以选课去重学生，返回退课率最高的课程，两年分别给出课程编号与退课率。
query: WITH b2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, student_id, MAX(is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 GROUP BY course_id, student_id ), r2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdraw_students_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_students_cnt FROM b2024 GROUP BY course_id ), b2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, student_id, MAX(is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 GROUP BY course_id, student_id ), r2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdraw_students_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_students_cnt FROM b2025 GROUP BY course_id ) (SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((r.withdraw_students_cnt / NULLIF(r.total_students_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM r2024 r JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = r.course_id ORDER BY withdraw_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((r.withdraw_students_cnt / NULLIF(r.total_students_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM r2025 r JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = r.course_id ORDER BY withdraw_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1);

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中教师工号去重数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT teacher_no) AS distinct_teacher_no_cnt FROM education_2024.teacher UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT teacher_no) AS distinct_teacher_no_cnt FROM education_2025.teacher;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程类型为必修且学分不低于4的课程数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_type='必修' AND credit>=4), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_type='必修' AND credit>=4) SELECT b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025两年共同存在的班级数，按班级编号，并计算共同班级中性别不同的学生数，去重学号。
query: WITH common_classes AS ( SELECT DISTINCT s2024.class_id FROM education_2024.enrollment e2024 JOIN education_2024.student s2024 ON s2024.student_id = e2024.student_id JOIN education_2025.enrollment e2025 ON e2025.student_id = e2024.student_id AND e2025.semester_id = e2024.semester_id JOIN education_2025.student s2025 ON s2025.student_id = e2025.student_id AND s2025.class_id = s2024.class_id ), common_students AS ( SELECT DISTINCT s2024.student_id, s2024.gender_code AS gender_2024, s2025.gender_code AS gender_2025 FROM education_2024.enrollment e2024 JOIN education_2024.student s2024 ON s2024.student_id = e2024.student_id JOIN education_2025.enrollment e2025 ON e2025.student_id = e2024.student_id AND e2025.semester_id = e2024.semester_id JOIN education_2025.student s2025 ON s2025.student_id = e2025.student_id WHERE s2024.class_id = s2025.class_id ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM common_classes) AS common_class_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(gender_2024, '') <> COALESCE(gender_2025, '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gender_diff_common_student_cnt FROM common_students;

question: 比较2024与2025学生表中性别为男性且性别非空的数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND gender_code='M' AND gender_code<>''), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND gender_code='M' AND gender_code<>'' ) SELECT b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程的平均总评折算分，排除退课，并返回两年平均值之差，即2025减2024。
query: WITH s2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), a2024 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_course_2024 FROM s2024 GROUP BY course_id), s2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), a2025 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_course_2025 FROM s2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(avg_total_course_2025) FROM a2025) - (SELECT AVG(avg_total_course_2024) FROM a2024),2) AS diff_avg_total_score_2025_minus_2024;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表课程名包含“化学”的课程数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_like_化学_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_name LIKE '%化学%' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_like_化学_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_name LIKE '%化学%';

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中电话为空或空字符串的教师数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.teacher WHERE phone IS NULL OR phone=''), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.teacher WHERE phone IS NULL OR phone='') SELECT b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中学分为0的课程数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS credit_0_course_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE credit=0 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS credit_0_course_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE credit=0;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每门课程的选课人数，去重学号，排名第一，按2025人数降序，返回课程编号与两年选课人数。
query: WITH p2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id), p2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT p2025.course_id, COALESCE(p2024.enroll_cnt_2024,0) AS enroll_cnt_2024, p2025.enroll_cnt_2025 FROM p2025 LEFT JOIN p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY p2025.enroll_cnt_2025 DESC, p2025.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中学分在0到2之间含边界的课程数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_credit_in_0_2_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE credit BETWEEN 0 AND 2 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_credit_in_0_2_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE credit BETWEEN 0 AND 2;

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中教师姓名包含“明”的数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_name_like_明_cnt FROM education_2024.teacher WHERE teacher_name LIKE '%明%' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_name_like_明_cnt FROM education_2025.teacher WHERE teacher_name LIKE '%明%';

question: 比较2024与2025学期表中学期代码按去重后共同的数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS common_semester_code_cnt FROM (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester WHERE semester_code IS NOT NULL AND semester_code<>'' ) a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester WHERE semester_code IS NOT NULL AND semester_code<>'' ) b ON b.semester_code=a.semester_code;

question: 比较2024与2025两年共同存在的课程编号中，学分在两年都非空且学分值相同的课程数量。
query: WITH common AS (SELECT a.course_id, a.credit AS credit_2024, b.credit AS credit_2025 FROM education_2024.course a JOIN education_2025.course b ON b.course_id=a.course_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS common_course_credit_same_cnt FROM common WHERE credit_2024 IS NOT NULL AND credit_2025 IS NOT NULL AND credit_2024=credit_2025;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程类型为必修且学分不低于5的课程数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_type='必修' AND credit>=5), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_type='必修' AND credit>=5) SELECT b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025学生表中性别为男性的数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS male_cnt FROM education_2024.student WHERE gender_code='M' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS male_cnt FROM education_2025.student WHERE gender_code='M';

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每个班级的平均参与人数，去重学号，先对班级统计再对班级取平均，返回两年平均值。
query: WITH p2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id ), p2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY s.class_id ) SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(enroll_cnt) FROM p2024), 2) AS avg_enroll_students_per_class_2024, ROUND((SELECT AVG(enroll_cnt) FROM p2025), 2) AS avg_enroll_students_per_class_2025;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程名以“计”开头的课程数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_start_计_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_name LIKE '计%' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_start_计_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_name LIKE '计%';

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中退课率最高的排名第一的课程，退课去重学生数除以选课去重学生数，返回两年各自的课程编号与退课率。
query: WITH b2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, student_id, MAX(is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 GROUP BY course_id, student_id ), r2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdraw_students_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_students_cnt FROM b2024 GROUP BY course_id ), b2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, student_id, MAX(is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 GROUP BY course_id, student_id ), r2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdraw_students_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_students_cnt FROM b2025 GROUP BY course_id ) (SELECT '2024' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((r.withdraw_students_cnt / NULLIF(r.total_students_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM r2024 r JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = r.course_id ORDER BY withdraw_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT '2025' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((r.withdraw_students_cnt / NULLIF(r.total_students_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM r2025 r JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = r.course_id ORDER BY withdraw_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1);

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程类型为选修的课程名非空数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS elective_course_name_not_empty_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_type='选修' AND course_name IS NOT NULL AND course_name<>'' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS elective_course_name_not_empty_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_type='选修' AND course_name IS NOT NULL AND course_name<>'';

question: 比较2024与2025学生表中家庭地区编号为2且学籍状态为在读的数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND home_region_id=2), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE' AND home_region_id=2) SELECT b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025学期表中结束日期键为空的记录数，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS end_date_key_is_null_cnt FROM education_2024.semester WHERE end_date_key IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS end_date_key_is_null_cnt FROM education_2025.semester WHERE end_date_key IS NULL;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中退课人数最多的排名第一课程，退课去重学生数，返回课程编号与两年退课学生数。
query: WITH w2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_students_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 AND is_withdraw = 1 GROUP BY course_id ), w2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS withdraw_students_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id = 1 AND is_withdraw = 1 GROUP BY course_id ), top_course AS ( SELECT course_id FROM w2025 ORDER BY withdraw_students_2025 DESC, course_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT t.course_id, COALESCE(w2024.withdraw_students_2024, 0) AS withdraw_students_2024, COALESCE(w2025.withdraw_students_2025, 0) AS withdraw_students_2025 FROM top_course t LEFT JOIN w2024 ON w2024.course_id = t.course_id LEFT JOIN w2025 ON w2025.course_id = t.course_id;

question: 比较2024与2025两年共同存在的学生数量，学号相同，以及其中性别不同的数量。
query: WITH common_students AS (SELECT a.student_id, a.gender_code AS gender_2024, b.gender_code AS gender_2025 FROM education_2024.student a JOIN education_2025.student b ON b.student_id=a.student_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS common_student_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(gender_2024,'')<>COALESCE(gender_2025,'') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gender_diff_common_cnt FROM common_students;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中院系编号在两年都存在的部门，返回这些院系编号及两年课程数差值，即2025减2024。
query: WITH c2024 AS (SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course GROUP BY department_id), c2025 AS (SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course GROUP BY department_id) SELECT c2025.department_id, c2024.cnt_2024, c2025.cnt_2025, c2025.cnt_2025-c2024.cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM c2025 JOIN c2024 ON c2024.department_id=c2025.department_id ORDER BY diff_2025_minus_2024 DESC, c2025.department_id ASC;

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中电话不为空且不为空字符串的教师数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_phone_non_empty_cnt FROM education_2024.teacher WHERE phone IS NOT NULL AND phone<>'' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS teacher_phone_non_empty_cnt FROM education_2025.teacher WHERE phone IS NOT NULL AND phone<>'';

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程的通过率差值最大的排名第一课程，通过率不低于60，通过率等于通过去重学生数除以总去重学生数，返回课程编号及两年通过率。
query: WITH base2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, MAX(CASE WHEN e.is_withdraw=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS keep_flag FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), score2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), agg2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2024 GROUP BY course_id), base2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), score2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), agg2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS total_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score>=60 THEN student_id END) AS pass_cnt FROM score2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c2025.course_id, ROUND((a2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(a2025.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_pct_2025, ROUND((a2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(a2024.total_cnt,0))*100,2) AS pass_rate_pct_2024 FROM agg2025 a2025 JOIN agg2024 a2024 ON a2024.course_id=a2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c2025 ON c2025.course_id=a2025.course_id ORDER BY (a2025.pass_cnt/NULLIF(a2025.total_cnt,0)-a2024.pass_cnt/NULLIF(a2024.total_cnt,0)) DESC, c2025.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 比较2024与2025学生表中学籍状态为在读的总人数差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE'), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE') SELECT b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025退课记录行数差，学期一且退课标记为1，返回差值与两年退课行数。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS withdraw_rows_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS withdraw_rows_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1) SELECT b.withdraw_rows_2025-a.withdraw_rows_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.withdraw_rows_2024, b.withdraw_rows_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每门课程的退课行数前3，按2025退课行数降序，返回课程编号与两年退课行数。
query: WITH w2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS withdraw_rows_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1 GROUP BY course_id), w2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS withdraw_rows_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=1 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT sel.course_id, COALESCE(w2024.withdraw_rows_2024,0) AS withdraw_rows_2024, COALESCE(w2025.withdraw_rows_2025,0) AS withdraw_rows_2025 FROM (SELECT course_id FROM w2025 ORDER BY withdraw_rows_2025 DESC, course_id ASC LIMIT 3) sel LEFT JOIN w2024 ON w2024.course_id=sel.course_id LEFT JOIN w2025 ON w2025.course_id=sel.course_id ORDER BY withdraw_rows_2025 DESC, sel.course_id ASC;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程名包含“物理”的数量，返回两年数量。

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中教师工号去重后数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT teacher_no) AS distinct_teacher_no_2024 FROM education_2024.teacher), b AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT teacher_no) AS distinct_teacher_no_2025 FROM education_2025.teacher) SELECT b.distinct_teacher_no_2025-a.distinct_teacher_no_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.distinct_teacher_no_2024, b.distinct_teacher_no_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程的平均参与人数，去重学号后对课程求平均，返回两年平均值。
query: WITH p2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id), p2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(enroll_cnt) FROM p2024),2) AS avg_enroll_students_per_course_2024, ROUND((SELECT AVG(enroll_cnt) FROM p2025),2) AS avg_enroll_students_per_course_2025;

question: 比较2024与2025学期表中学期代码为空或空字符串的行数，返回两年数量。

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程类型为必修的学分平均值差，即2025减2024，返回均值与差值。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT AVG(credit) AS avg_credit_2024 FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_type='必修'), b AS (SELECT AVG(credit) AS avg_credit_2025 FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_type='必修') SELECT ROUND(b.avg_credit_2025-a.avg_credit_2024,2) AS diff_avg_credit_2025_minus_2024, ROUND(a.avg_credit_2024,2) AS avg_credit_2024, ROUND(b.avg_credit_2025,2) AS avg_credit_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每个班级的退课率，退课去重学生除以选课去重学生，对所有班级求平均，返回两年平均退课率。
query: WITH base2024 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.course_id, e.student_id, MAX(e.is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.course_id, e.student_id ), byclass2024 AS ( SELECT class_id, (SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM base2024 GROUP BY class_id ), base2025 AS ( SELECT s.class_id, e.course_id, e.student_id, MAX(e.is_withdraw) AS is_withdraw FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 GROUP BY s.class_id, e.course_id, e.student_id ), byclass2025 AS ( SELECT class_id, (SUM(CASE WHEN is_withdraw = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 AS withdraw_rate_pct FROM base2025 GROUP BY class_id ) SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(withdraw_rate_pct) FROM byclass2024), 2) AS avg_class_withdraw_rate_pct_2024, ROUND((SELECT AVG(withdraw_rate_pct) FROM byclass2025), 2) AS avg_class_withdraw_rate_pct_2025;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中院系编号对应课程数差值前3，按差值绝对值降序，返回院系编号与两年课程数、差值。
query: WITH c2024 AS (SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course GROUP BY department_id), c2025 AS (SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course GROUP BY department_id), diff AS (SELECT COALESCE(c2025.department_id,c2024.department_id) AS department_id, COALESCE(c2024.cnt_2024,0) AS cnt_2024, COALESCE(c2025.cnt_2025,0) AS cnt_2025, COALESCE(c2025.cnt_2025,0)-COALESCE(c2024.cnt_2024,0) AS diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM c2025 LEFT JOIN c2024 ON c2024.department_id=c2025.department_id UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(c2025.department_id,c2024.department_id) AS department_id, COALESCE(c2024.cnt_2024,0) AS cnt_2024, COALESCE(c2025.cnt_2025,0) AS cnt_2025, COALESCE(c2025.cnt_2025,0)-COALESCE(c2024.cnt_2024,0) AS diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM c2024 LEFT JOIN c2025 ON c2025.department_id=c2024.department_id WHERE c2025.department_id IS NULL) SELECT department_id, cnt_2024, cnt_2025, diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM (SELECT * FROM diff ORDER BY ABS(diff_2025_minus_2024) DESC, department_id ASC) t LIMIT 3;
